notes.title: Devlog #86 - Path to Greatness
notes.notes: [p]Welcome Talented Gamers![/p][p][/p][p]It's time for another run down of what's been happening over here at TurtleFox Games in the last couple of weeks![/p][p][/p][p]Obviously, we've been hard at work on both the New Game and New DLC we [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2435090/view/524226158154220066"]announced in the last Devlog[/url] along with our Roadmap. You'll be hearing more about those in the near future, but first of all we want to talk about what's coming on the Free Update side of 1.3.[/p][p][/p][h3]More Mastery Levels[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/063f7ceb7348e8fd72b1cdbb31e9d69507a98c2b.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]1.3 will see the addition of another 5 Mastery Levels, allowing you to climb to the heights of Mastery 35. Just like when we added Mastery 30, we want to add to unique difficulty increases that should spice up the game for our long time players.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/6981174a8b498cc12ce0f205b8c8ae1f6cc6d4f3.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We're using Mastery 31 to introduce some Endless Mode elements into the base game. You'll be seeing the Rare Curses like power up Elites and even make enemies deal more damage earlier in the run.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/b63fc79932bc83aba0a4e2a0784f71b63d2c97cc.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]At Mastery 32 - Glitched Elites will begin to appear, these slippery enemies will teleport when they are within a certain range from you. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/9cefc6ced18bf665895e8b458bf2a6c541510ea5.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]A request from one of our community members was to experiment with introducing elements from Waves into Standard Runs. Obviously we want to keep the two game modes distinct, but Mastery 35 (the big one!) will do exactly that![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/57f83857b1c4ae5bb33ee74e6c1f37a415acda4f.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/dd72a52d704d6f9ddbb9f90d46e0eddf24093aa1.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We'll leave the other 2 for you to discover when the update drops! We're expecting this to be our most challenging difficulty increase yet in Standard Runs. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/bd514ddf17fb9bf4fa06a65da1243e21de10ef58.gif"][/img][/p][p]Thankfully we're introducing a new feature next Devlog that should give you even more options when constructing your build... Until then...[/p][p][/p][p][i]Stay Talented[/i][/p]

notes.title: Devlog #85 - Next Steps
notes.notes: [p]Hello Talented Gamers![/p][p][/p][p]Thank you to everyone who logged on for our 1.2 Update release, and an extra special thank you to all of our new Chinese players that are making the most of our Chinese (Simplified) localization! We've been so pleased to see the game find a new audience.[/p][p][/p][p]Now that it's been a couple of weeks since the update dropped, it's time again to talk about what's next for us at TurtleFox Games.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/67cf3f7a972e5b86dac547a92da7efb550c488c5.png"][/img][/p][h3]Update 1.3[/h3][p][/p][p]Our goal this year is to release one more update closer to the size of our 1.1 Update. This will include new features, new quality of life changes, new achievements and the bug fixing/balance improvements you've come to expect.[/p][p][/p][p]We'll be diving into what's coming with 1.3 in the next devlog, so stay tuned for more on that![/p][p][/p][h3]A New DLC[/h3][p][/p][p]We've started early design work on a second DLC that will release at the same time as the 1.3 update. Feedback was overall positive with Wave of Shadows so we'll be using that as a general guide for what to add.[/p][p][/p][p]You can expect a new Class, new Challenges, new Game Mode and a brand new Environment. Our plan is to begin with an announcement in early October and, as always, we'll be sharing updates on our design and development process and listening to player feedback along the way![/p][p][/p][h3]The Second Game[/h3][p][/p][p]If you've been following these devlogs for a while, you'll remember that just after the 1.0 release of Talented I teased that we'd begun work on a second title. That has continued and we're really happy with how it's turning out. [/p][p][/p][p]The current plan is to Announce our second game before the end of the year and to have a playable demo here on Steam early next year. Everyone here will be the first to know what it is and where you can get more information - so keep an eye on our news posts to stay up to speed with that.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Important Note:[/b] We are [b][u]not[/u][/b] planning on stopping Talented development to work on the second game, both will be happening side by side.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/bd514ddf17fb9bf4fa06a65da1243e21de10ef58.gif"][/img][/p][p]That about covers it for our Roadmap from this point - we can't wait to hear what you think of everything that's planned, ever since we first released Talented on Steam this has been an amazing ride and we're thankful for the oppertunity to keep making things for you![/p][p][/p][p][i]Stay Talented[/i][/p]

notes.title: Talented 1.2 Update - Spectral Spectrum
notes.notes:
[p]Greetings Talented Gamers![/p][p][/p][p]It's update time, and there's a load to talk about as always... So let's dive right in![/p][p][/p][h3]Chinese Localization[/h3][p][/p][p]We've been asked countless time to help Talented reach a wider audience by adding more language options, and we're starting this update with Chinese (Simplified)![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/bb9274921c037c0782a6e584d539788ed9bba7ee.png"][/img][/p][h3]Mythic Talents[/h3][p][/p][p]Access the highest tier of Talents so far with the new, fully colour, fully unique Mythic Talents.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/db4dd88bd7103e293ed681b3c05e4cc5b1e9232a.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Each Class has their own to discover, and each introduces a special mechanic for that Class - we're looking forward to seeing how they impact your runs. 
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/c6ae9450140b736e53171988cb7474c0e99d5141.gif"][/img][/p][p]
Mythics are unlocked after you've learnt a Legendary Talent and entered a Portal in any previous run, if you've already done those things you'll have a chance to discover them immediately![/p][p][/p][h3]Chromoprisms[/h3][p][/p][p]After hundreds of runs, it's about time Ed sees the world through new eyes. Chromoprisms allow you to change the colour pallete of the game.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/8d6510d0613d45a75876692fe35a31be8ad4bc98.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Each Class can unlock a unique Chromoprism once Mastery 10 has been completed. Which will be your favourite?[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/102ce9376e053f0ce05d3a8a5d0b60187d450126.png"][/img][/p][h3]Quality of Life and More...[/h3][p][/p][p]1.2 introduces a few things that didn't quite make the 1.1 update and some additional things that have been frequently requested since.[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]You can now scroll through all Curses in the Run Info Panel[/p][/*][*][p]There is now a Run In Background setting in the Settings Menu[/p][/*][*][p]You can now choose to randomize the Environment each run in the Environments Menu[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]There will also be 4 new Achievements to unlock (that don't require the Wave of Shadows DLC), and a special secret in the Factory to discover.[/p][p][/p][h3]Balance[/h3][p][/p][p][b]General[/b][/p][p][i]With the introduction of Mythic Talents we're making Legendaries slightly more accessable to give them a more distinct place in our Talent system.[/i][/p][list][*][p]Legendary Talents now cost 3 Talent Points (down from 5)[/p][/*][*][p]Legendary Talents now appear lower on the tree and slightly more often[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Archer[/b][/p][p][i]While mostly in a good place when it comes to build variety and power, we're finding homing missiles (especially with Vortech Turrets) are guarenteeing a win more often than we'd like. We also feel like Trap have never really had a chance to shine. [/i][/p][list][*][p]Frost Trap now deals 100% of your Attack Damage (up from 50%),[/p][/*][*][p]Spike Trap now deals 100% of your Attack Damage (up from 50%),[/p][/*][*][p]Blast Cannon cooldown reduced to 15 seconds (down from 35 seconds),[/p][/*][*][p]Rocket Man duration reduced to 3 seconds (down from 5 seconds),[/p][/*][*][p]Vortech Bounty requirement down to 15 (down from 25),[/p][/*][*][p]Vortech Bounty Homing Missiles to 1 (down from 2)[/p][/*][*][p]Vortech Turrets are now destroyed after 2 hits (down from 4)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Wizard[/b][/p][p][i]We're reducing the cooldown of some of the more prohibitively high cooldown Wizard Abilities. Originally they were made high to balance them around powerful cooldown reduction builds - but it's mostly just served to discourage people from taking them early in the run.[/i][/p][list][*][p]Ring Theory Cooldown reduced to 15 seconds (down from 30),[/p][/*][*][p]Illuminate Bonus Experience increased to 25% (up from 15%),[/p][/*][*][p]Conjure Weapon cooldown reduced to 30s (down from 40s),[/p][/*][*][p]Atomize Cooldown reduced to 15s (down from 30s),[/p][/*][*][p]Atomize bonus Orb Damage reduced to 3 (down from 5),[/p][/*][*][p]Meteor Damage increased to 15 (up from 5)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Warrior[/b][/p][p][i]We've reduced the cooldown of some of the less often learnt Abilities to give them a chance to find a home![/i][/p][list][*][p]Earthquake Cooldown reduced to 20s (Down from 30s),[/p][/*][*][p]Electric Hook Cooldown reduced to 12s (down from 15s),[/p][/*][*][p]Intimidating Strike cooldown reduced to 15s (down from 30s)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Summoner[/b][/p][p][i]Summoner can sometimes feel like he only gets to use 1-2 Abilities per Night in the early game, so we're reducing the base cooldown of his iconic Summon Abilities to give him a few more options and make competitive when compared with the Snail/Gravestone enhancing options.[/i][/p][list][*][p]Increased Summoner's Knockback Power in Waves Mode by an additional 50%,[/p][/*][*][p]Squelchomega's Cooldown reduced to 18s (down from 20s),[/p][/*][*][p]Infestation Cooldown reduced to 15s (down from 20s),[/p][/*][*][p]Spookantation Cooldown reduced to 15s (down from 20s),[/p][/*][*][p]Flockreath Cooldown reduced to 8s (down from 15s),[/p][/*][*][p]Pumpkania Cooldown reduced to 18s (down from 20s),[/p][/*][*][p]Snail of Arrows Cooldown reduced to 22s (down from 30s),[/p][/*][*][p]Squelchomination Cooldown reduced to 30s (down from 45s),[/p][/*][*][p]Royalty Cooldown reduced to 35s (down from 45s)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Bandit[/b][/p][p][i]We've had quite a bit of feedback that Bandit can feel like he's lacking build variety and also that too many of his Talent Packages are focussed on either Experience or Gold gain. So we've introduced a new win condition and 2 new Talent Packages that give him immediate power![/i][/p][list][*][p]The \[Top Frag] Talent Package has been replaced with a new Package focussed on Final Shot Talents[/p][/*][*][p]The \[Investment] Talent Package has been replaced with a new Package focussed on a brand new Ghost Pistol Mechanic[/p][/*][*][p]Market Surge has been replaced with \[Eclipse] - Gain 10% Critical Strike Chance until the end of the Night. Gain X Ghost Pistols (One for every 20% Critical Strike Chance you have)[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/5eb4e5f99d4a6788da54c2a9e5dee62fdeff4d65.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Alchemist[/b][/p][p][i]We're fairly fresh off an Alchemist rework in March and we're relatively happy with where the class is at - having said that there are definitely under-performing Talent Packages we'd like to make more appealing. This time we've added significant power into the Secret Recipe package.[/i][/p][list][*][p]Signiture Dish bonus experience increased to 10% (up from 5%),[/p][/*][*][p]Primordial bonus Ability Damage increased to 50% per Status Effect (up from 25%)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Ninja[/b][/p][p][i]Ninja is powerful no matter which win condition you're focussed on, and our veteran players are often consistently getting all of his win conditions at the same time! Usually we'd consider more significant nerfs when a Class is in this spot - but all of the feedback we've had is he's a ton of fun to play as he is.[/i][/p][p][i]For that reason, we'll just focus on shaving some of the strength off the Momentum mechanic to stop Ability focussed builds from going infinite quite as quickly. We'll be keeping an eye out for feedback in case further changes to Ninja are needed in the future.[/i][/p][list][*][p]Momentum now reduces Cooldowns by 3% per use (down from 5%),[/p][/*][*][p]Clear Mind now increases Momentum's Cooldown reduction to 6% (down from 10%)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][p][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where Ninja Challenges could be accessed using Gamepad Input even without owning the DLC[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Speedrun Achievement could be unlocked on Classes other than Ninja[/p][/*][*][p]Enabling Relics now grants bonus Class Experience in Waves Mode[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Lock and Load would enchant 4 Basic Attacks instead of 3[/p][/*][*][p]Any gold generated in excess of the loot object per frame limit (e.g. Mining Operation granting more than 50 Gold) will now be instantly added to your Gold resource[/p][/*][*][p]Barricades will now always be knocked back slightly even when enemies have 100% knockback resistance[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where Bonus Mastery Levels would claim to be unlocked even if they'd been unlocked before[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected the Tooltip for "Shot Count" to say there is a maximum of 10 shots per Basic Attack[/p][/*][*][p]Scatterpult now allows you to increase your Critical Strike Chance beyond 100% when you also have Edge of Infinity[/p][/*][*][p]You can no longer pause the game during the death sequence[/p][/*][*][p]Spectral Quiver no longer appears in the Supply Chain Challenge[/p][/*][*][p]Explosive Rounds no longer appears in the Gold Rush Challenge[/p][/*][*][p]Victory Pose no longer appears in the Weapon Swap Challenge[/p][/*][*][p]The Obsolete War Cry Ability no longer appears in the Weapon Swap Challenge[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the accuracy of the Meteor hit box[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Various Typos[/p][/*][/list][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/bd514ddf17fb9bf4fa06a65da1243e21de10ef58.gif"][/img][/p][p]And there we have it... Another update for our most Talented Gamers to enjoy! I'll be back in a couple of weeks to talk about what's next for Talented... and... beyond...?[/p][p][/p][p]Until then...[/p][p][/p][p][i]Stay Talented[/i][/p]

notes.title: Devlog #84 - Save the Date
notes.notes: [p]Greetings Talented Gamers![/p][p][/p][p]Time for the final Devlog before the 1.2 update! We're excited to announce that everything we've been talking about over the last 2 months will be available when...[/p][p][/p][p][b]The 1.2 Update launches Friday 22nd August![/b][/p][p][/p][p]So, let's talk about the last few things you can expect![/p][p][/p][h3]Chinese (Simplified) Localization is Here![/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/cc2b3f62503354ff4d16bdc68b1b6c2712f50b05.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We're wrapping up our work on translating Talented to it's second language. We want to thank the guys over at [url="https://www.leveluptranslation.com/"]Level Up Translation[/url] for their hard work making over 30,000 words readable in Chinese (Simplified).[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/bb9274921c037c0782a6e584d539788ed9bba7ee.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]As with everything, we'll be keeping a close eye out for anything we've missed or any incorrect translations. We know people have been asking for Chinese Language Support for Talented for a while so we're hoping this will be a useful feature to many![/p][p][/p][h3]Save Backups[/h3][p][/p][p]From time to time, a Save File corrupts and goes missing. Although rare, it can be devistating for anyone it happens to as Save Files can be 10s or even 100s of hours of play time.[/p][p][/p][p]While we can't really stop Save File from corrupting when a power cut or unexpected crash happens during the save process, we can definitely do a better job of backing up your Save File so it's easier to recover.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/a9fffd1bea3fa6a36d204f466b32e5a31d0f56dc.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Starting in 1.2, in addition to your Cloud Save, you will generate a local backup of your Save File. This means if you Save File on the cloud is corrupted, you'll be able to override it and recover most of your progress. The backup save will only be overwritten if you complete a run on a higher mastery than the backup save contains.[/p][p][/p][h3]New Achievements[/h3][p][/p][p]1.2 will contain 4 new Achievement to increase us to a nice round 200. This should be very simple unlocks for anyone who already has 100%, but will be a good excuse to try out our new content![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/39ce67c493b1f1aa394dc6655f9a7f659edc62e0.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/bd514ddf17fb9bf4fa06a65da1243e21de10ef58.gif"][/img][/p][p]And that's that! We'll have a full set of release notes dropping with 1.2 in a couple of weeks that will summarise everything we've added and include our Bug Fixes and other Balance Changes... Until then...[/p][p][/p][p][i]Stay Talented[/i][/p]

notes.title: Devlog #83 - Haunted Holsters
notes.notes: [p]Greetings Talented Gamers![/p][p][/p][p]It's devlog time again, and we have a couple of different things to reveal! But first... something very exciting happened during the Steam Summer Sale![/p][p][/p][p][b]There are now over 100,000 Talented Gamers![/b][/p][p][/p][p]We never expected our tiny little game to reach such an amazing community! So from everyone here at the Talented Team, thank you so much for giving it a chance and giving us the motivation to keep making games![/p][p][/p][p]Speaking of making games... Let's take a look at some new stuf![/p][p][/p][h3]New Bandit Build[/h3][p][/p][p]It has been on our radar for a while that too many of Bandit's Talent Packages are "economy" packages that give you access to more gold, or combo points.[/p][p][/p][p]This means Bandit can sometimes feel lacking in the build variety department. So we're introducing a brand new Bandit win condition - [b]The Ghost Pistol[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/5eb4e5f99d4a6788da54c2a9e5dee62fdeff4d65.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Ghost Pistols orbit close to the player and fire off a Basic Attack whenever they pass through a lane. They each have 3 ammo, and when they run out they're gone for good.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/6166b00124cb55b9929964b270a99560676f5af9.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We'll be adding a few different ways of gaining Ghost Pistols to the game, and they will be getting their very own Talent Package with some powerful synergies to top off the build.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/f05830fcbdd46aabbe4c804f06418b7f108fd12a.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/b188973cca0cf28de11e7be3a6ccdbb16475ec43.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Ghost Pistols should be hitting the beta branch in the coming weeks, so we're looking forward to hearing your feedback![/p][p][/p][h3]Quality of Life[/h3][p][/p][p]Update 1.2 will also see the introduction of a few frequently requested QoL changes![/p][list][*][p]We'll be adding a Run In Background option to the Settings Menu[/p][/*][*][p]We'll be adding the option to have your Environment randomly selected each run[/p][/*][*][p]We'll be adding more Gameplay Elements and tracking in the stats screen for in game objects (e.g. Wizard's Orbs and Summoner's Gravestones)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]There will be a full breakdown in the 1.2 Release Notes when the update drops![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/bd514ddf17fb9bf4fa06a65da1243e21de10ef58.gif"][/img][/p][p]We're starting to close in on the release of this update, so I'll be running through some of the final changes you can expect in the next Devlog! Until then...[/p][p][/p][p][i]Stay Talented[/i][/p]

notes.title: Devlog #82 - Beyond Legendary
notes.notes: [p]Welcome Back Talented Gamers![/p][p][/p][p]It's time for another update on our 1.2 progress! This week we'll be breaking through the ceiling with a brand new Rarity of Talents![/p][p][/p][h3]Mythic Talents![/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/4f131e0a39230377ca39c5770e327f78b66f0a45.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]These top of the line upgrades are intended to be our most impactful yet. Each one will add a brand new mechanic to their class that has both immediate impact and can be a build around under the right circumstances.[/p][p][/p][p]They come with everything you'd expect, a unique look on the tree, and brand new jingle for when you learn them - and our very first Colour Talent Icons![/p][p][/p][p]We'll be starting by adding one Mythic per Class but, if you guys like them, we'll continue to add more as development goes on! So let's reveal a few for our original classes![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/db4dd88bd7103e293ed681b3c05e4cc5b1e9232a.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]With Supply Drop, Archer will be getting regular supply crates containing XP, loot and other useful objects from across the game.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/6c7904583b9c31ef185cd6a507ea298cb5149ff3.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]You can increase the rate of Supply Crates by discovering Talent Packages so all of that bonus XP can go to good use![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/8badd239da0a4306c1418522c969e38c86abcf86.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]As Wizard you can max out your build with the most powerful Orb of all - better yet as you discover more Talent Packages it will create Novas more and more often![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/c6ae9450140b736e53171988cb7474c0e99d5141.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/b1cd4746f55d913728f7de1ba75455379e4a60a2.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]...and Warrior will be getting his most powerful Throwing Weapon Talent yet! As you'd expect, these Medals will be doing huge amounts of damage even without synergies - but if you can find ways to increase the Combo Meter even further than usual you might even break the record for highest damage dealt![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/e79cf3d8219182d432f29707d6a75fcb1c24ea22.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]As powerful as these Talents are, they won't be guarenteed to appear in every run. We're currently experimenting with around a 1/3 change per Talent Tree - which should make them more obtainable on our Portal hopping Classes but a little more of a high roll on classes like Warrior and Bandit.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/bd514ddf17fb9bf4fa06a65da1243e21de10ef58.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]As for the rest of the Mythic Talents, we'll be keeping those to ourselves until the update drops. Next Devlog, we'll be talking about some of the Quality of Life changes coming in 1.2. Until next time...[/p][p][/p][p][i]Stay Talented[/i][/p]

notes.title: Devlog #81 - Hue Knew?
notes.notes: [p]Hello Talented Gamers![/p][p][/p][p]This week we'll be diving into what you can expect in the 1.2 update coming soon.[/p][p][/p][h3]Localisation Begins![/h3][p][/p][p]With over 23,000 words, it's no surprise that we've had a ton of requests for localisation for Talented. I'm sure you can understand that it's both a time consuming and expensive process - so we're rolling it out slowly so we can gauge continued interest and spot any missing translations/bugs as we go![/p][p][/p][p]1.2 will introduce our very first language (and by far our most requested)... [b]Chinese (Simplified)[/b][/p][p][/p][p]We understand how important being able to read our Talent, Ability and Enemy descriptions in your own language can be, especially when things get complicated - so we're looking to add additional language options as soon as we can.[/p][p][/p][h3]Chromoprisms[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/102ce9376e053f0ce05d3a8a5d0b60187d450126.png"][/img][/p][p]Another common request is the ability to change the colour palette of Talented. Those of you that checked out the Wave of Shadows DLC may have seen that the Ninja's Singularity Ability did exactly that - and with that test complete we're happy rolling out Chromoprisms as a core feature![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/8d6510d0613d45a75876692fe35a31be8ad4bc98.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Each Class will have an unlockable colour scheme for winning a run on Mastery 10. That means many of our veteran players will have instant access to 7 colour schemes![/p][p][/p][p]As with everything else we'll be looking to expand this feature as development continues![/p][p][/p][h3]And More...[/h3][p][/p][p]We'll be diving into these features in the coming devlogs but you can look forward to:[/p][list][*][p][b]Mythic Talents - [/b]A new tier of Talent that adds a new unique feature to the class when purchased.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Factory Secret - [/b]With the positive response the secret of Nightshade Grove recieved we though it was only fair that we added one to our Build-A-Beast Factory too![/p][/*][*][p][b]New Achievements - [/b]We're adding a few simple Achievements to support our new features in this update[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bug Fixes/Balance/QoL -[/b] As always![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/bd514ddf17fb9bf4fa06a65da1243e21de10ef58.gif"][/img][/p][p]Hopefully that's a fair bit to look forward to! [/p][p][/p][p]As we mentioned in the previous devlog, this is a smaller update - so you can expect it a bit sooner than 1.1 and then we'll be talking about what's next for our next content addition.[/p][p][/p][p]Next week we'll be talking Mythic Talents! Until then...[/p][p][/p][p][i]Stay Talented[/i][/p]

notes.title: Talented 1.1 Update - Be Kind Rebind
notes.notes:
Greetings Talented Gamers!

Thanks to the overwhelming support Talented has recieved since release I'm proud to present our first major update along with the release of our Wave of Shadows DLC.

Just in case you haven't kept fully up to date on Talented news - everything in the first part of these release notes is available as part of the standard Talented games, but everything after the "Wave of Shadows" header is part of our new DLC available here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3423250/Talented__Wave_of_Shadows/

Let's get to it!

[h2]Key Rebinding[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/cf3b96fa677d90912a09b64497a375a3ad3b01e8.png[/img]

The much requested Key Rebinding feature is here. Now you can do anything from switch your Ability uses to whatever key you like. 

It's also a useful way of seeing some of the lesser known hotkey utilities in Talented!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/ac9abb13c3ee74d7871997464e46aed129297f60.png[/img]

[h2]Mastery 30[/h2]

A brand new level of challenge is now available with Mastery 30. Brave the barricades and take on bosses with 5 new difficulty levels to attempt.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/8c0bb6b737e155912327c0ccac5e3803cc125791.png[/img]

[h2]Build-A-Beast Factory[/h2]

For those who have completed a run on all 6 original Talented classes, a new environment will be available the moment you log in. (Anyone new to the game can unlock it by winning a run on each class!)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/73a419c6b4fdf1f285c7da45efa822636a89e0a2.gif[/img]

[h2]Balance[/h2]

[h3]General[/h3]
[i]Even post-launch we're continuing to pay close attention to standard run feedback. Although we stand by our decision to make our Common Talents very simple to understand, we do think there's space for a few more Rare Talents in the mix. Same goes for Abilities.

In addition, nothing feels worse than just about reaching a Talent Package and not actually being able to use the Talents from it so we're removing the cost from discovering Talent Packages.[/i]

[list]
[*] Increased the number of reconnections on the skill tree, and changed its shape to reduce the number of dead ends
[*] Increased the chance of Talents being Rare by 25% accross all classes
[*] Abilities can now appear much lower on the tree
[*] Talent Packages no longer cost Talent Points to discover
[*] The Divinity Curse now blocks the first instance of damage deal (down from the first 3)
[*] The Fortified Curse now reduces maximum damage dealt to 350 (up from 250)
[*] The Unwavering Curse damage reduction down to 50% (from 75%)
[*] The Ravenous Curse damage reduction down to 35% (from 50%)
[*] Reduced the XP required to level up at high levels
[*] Shrunk enemies now always deal 5 damage (even if they are elite)
[/list]
[h3]Archer[/h3]
[list]
[*] Gumball Collector gumballs now grant 2% Attack Speed (down from 3%)
[*] Preparation now also increases Trap damage by 5
[*] Battery Pack reworked to - Gain X random Common Talents (one for each charge your Abilities have)
[*] Vortech Turrets now appear slightly closer to you
[*] Vortech Turret cooldown increased to 30s (up from 15s)
[*] Vortech Turret maximum turret count reduced to 4 (down from 10)
[*] Vortehc Turret time between missiles increased to 3 (up from 2.5s)
[/list]
[h3]Wizard[/h3]
[list]
[*] Bracing Knowledge now also restored 5 Health Points on Level Up
[*] Straight Flush now grants 25% Ability Power per Ability (up from 15%)
[*] Conjure Weapon cooldown reduced to 40s (down from 60s)
[*] Royal Flush now grants 8% bonus experience per Ability (up from 5%)
[/list]
[h3]Warrior[/h3]
[i]While we were generally happy with Warrior's performance in standard runs, he was having a hard time in the Endless Modes... We've cooked up some changes that should make the upper end of his truly broken builds even more broken.[/i]

[list]
[*] Warrior can now learn Experience Up Talents and can no longer learn Health Regen Up Talents
[*] "Combo" Talents have been renamed to "Chain" Talents
[*] All Chain Talents now remain active until the end of the night
[*] All Planned has been replaced by [Victory Tale] - Your Chain Talents give double their bonus when you reach a [Brilliant] Combo
[*] Throwing Weapons now increase their activation rate whenever you buy an Attack Speed Up Talent
[*] Time between Throwing Weapon Talent Activations increased to 6s (up from 4s)
[*] Minimum time between Throwing Weapon Talent Activations reduced to 0.25s (down from 1s)
[*] Time Between health restores from Health Regen is reduced to 10s (down from 15s)
[*] The Impaler's Health Requirement is increased to 25 per AD (up from 20)
[*] Tranquil Chain Health Regen down to 10% (down from 12%)
[*] Lethal Chain Critical Strike Chance down to 5% (down from 8%)
[*] Savage Chain Attack Speed down to 10% (down from 15%)
[*] Colossal Chain Size increase down to 10% (down from 15%)
[*] Blood Pact Attack Speed down to 5% (down from 10%)
[*] Well Aged bonus experience per 10 Max Health increased to 10% (from 5%)
[/list]
[h3]Summoner[/h3]
[list]
[*] You can no longer Lifesteal from Flies
[*] Mind Rend activation chance increased to 100% (up from 20%)
[*] The Horde Summon Speed bonus reduced to 8% (down from 10%)
[*] Overclock activation chance increased to 20% (up from 10%)
[*] Overflow activation chance increased to 20% (up from 10%)
[/list]
[h3]Bandit[/h3]
[list]
[*] Bandit now has fewer Knockback Up Talents
[*] Bandit can now learn Experience Up Talents
[*] Deposit increased number of treasures fired by 2 per shop entry (up from 1)
[*] Assassination reworked to - Basic Attacks on Confused targets deal damage equal to an additional 5% of their Maximum Health
[*] Tarot Card reworked to - Tarot Card to Learn 2 Random Common Talents, when you have at least 100% Luck learn 2 more
[*] Dexterous Combo has been reworked into Dexterous Chain - While you have a [Skilled] Combo your Reload Speed is increased by 10% until the end of the Night (in line with the Warrior Changes)
[*] Mine Carts from Mining Operation now appear much closer to you
[/list]
[h3]Alchemist[/h3]
[list]
[*] Sceptres now gain 2 damage for each item looted (up from 1)
[*] Chakrams now gain 2 damage for each Ability used (up from 1)
[*] Top Prize now grants 20 combo points (up from 10)
[*] Repetitive now fires 1 additional bolt on activation (down from 2)
[/list]
[h3]Challenges[/h3]
[list]
[*] Enemies no longer spawn in the Whack-A-Rune Challenge
[*] Reduced the rune requirement and time allowed in the Whack-A-Rune Challenge
[*] Reduced the chance for enemies already caught to appear in the Gotta Summon All Challenge
[*] Reduced the cooldown of the Summon Orb in the Gotta Summon All Challenge and removed the Squelcharim Ability
[*] Reduced the HP of enemies in the Gotta Summon All Challenge
[/list]
[h3]Achievements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Pioneer now requires 600 Compendium Entries (to avoid confusion with the addition of Ninja/Hex/Enemy Pack sections to the Compendium)
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Reduced hit glow when dealing high damage to metallic elites
[*] The Next Night button is no longer enabled during the Wealth Management and Long Strange Trip challenges
[*] Fixed an issue where Diamond Rounds could be purchased without being unlocked.
[*] Funky Dealings deck no longer persists between runs.
[*] Roll With It can no longer appear in the Pirate's Life Challenge.
[*] Pruning Challenge no longer contains the outdated Cultivate skill in the talent tree; also fixed missing crit chance from the stats display.
[*] Focused Portal now appears correctly in the Compendium.
[*] The following Legendary Talents now correctly appear in runs and the compendium: Masterful Hat, Test Run, Regular Workout, Omnipotence, Regular Training, Booma-Rounds, Recall, and Regular Practice.
[*] Buffs that last until the end of the night are now correctly removed at the end of Night 20.
[*] Fixed an issue where Lil Blobs could die from the same attack that killed the Mega Blob that spawned them.
[*] Helix Squad’s Summon Speed buff can no longer be applied multiple times simultaneously.
[*] Finest Leather now correctly affects Gust Quiver.
[*] Pressing Esc during the initial fade into a run no longer pauses the game or spawns an invisible menu.
[*] Helping Hands now correctly removes the Luck bonus granted at the end of the night.
[*] Fixed an issue where Surplus wouldn't create all basic attacks due to exceeding the single-frame projectile count.
[*] Enemies that move between lanes no longer appear to pass behind walls.
[*] Slightly reduced the size of the flame effect created by Flame Snails.
[*] Legendary Talents can no longer appear in the Shop if already learned on the Talent Tree.
[*] Fixed an issue where the next Shop could briefly appear as the Shop Panel hides.
[*] Sponsorship now guarentees Rare of higher Talents even if you're not able to afford them
[*] Enemies and their VFX no longer appear on top of the end of run screen
[*] Fixed an issue where the Symbolic Achievement wouldn't always unlock even when you didn't miss a Rune in the Whack-A-Rune Challenge
[*] Fixed the Ability Count not correctly being increased in the Whack-A-Rune Challenge
[*] Using bumpers on Gamepad will no longer change between Settings Tabs while the Run Info panel is open
[*] Prosperous Portal will no longer add Legendary Talents to the bottom of multiple trees (instead only the one you teleport to)
[*] Closing the Combat Stat Panel while hovering a Stat will no longer cause the tooltip to remain active,
[*] Tronks can no longer heal while Burning
[*] You can no longer reroll the shop in the Pirate's Life challenge when using Gamepad
[*] Fixed various typos and grammar issue in text descriptions
[/list]

[h2]Quality of Life[/h2]
[list]
[*] Reduced the required hold time to restart a run.
[*] Added Ability Cooldowns, Costs and Charges to the Compendium
[*] The Challenges panel now opens to show your most recently selected Class
[*] Added a prompt showing your current level to Peer Review in the Long Strange Trip Challenge
[*] Axe Toss' Axes now increase in size based on their damage
[/list]

[h1]Wave of Shadows[/h1]

Looking for a new Talented challenge? With the Wave of Shadows DLC you'll have access to a new class, a complete new mode and plenty of unlockables to give you something to strive for! Let's take a look...

[h2]The Ninja[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/f8d8fb16696914a567974cedbf1f99fa0ba29556.gif[/img]

With Shurikens, Soulflames and our first ever movement Ability - Ninja enters the Talented Dungeon.

Complete Quests to gain Trophies, raise your Reputation with a chosen Clan and gain access to gamebreaking Ultimate Abilities.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/678923d97a102333c3b8f9f74bf60bb73b1c6ba6.png[/img]

Will you be one of the first to master the Ninja?

[h2]Waves Mode[/h2]

Ready for a new kind of Talented Challenge?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/60324c847d652f95ff4847bb8116079b4d6bc988.gif[/img]

Waves mode pits you against a random combination of hand crafted enemy formations. As you progress the you'll encounter more difficulty and diverse enemy packs and recieve powerful Hexes that will make taking them on even more challenging....

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/1f1d5d2d95dc0e622f78cb8dc08ec99ca916199e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/df33aa52621186884cff81cbfd5767ba35d46a65.png[/img]

You can also add additional modifier to your run with Cursed Relics.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/64647f54f94e3b81f1774f0b95bd0b37ae11c639.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/682de94c1528dbdb7d6eed7f246913faf3f76404.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/82554800e5f8bbc6a16c1aa1c00258f4cc47f36d.png[/img]

Mix and match them or apply them all of the ultimate Waves experience...

[h2]Nightshade Grove[/h2]

Wave of Shadows also comes with instant access to our beautiful forest environment and home of the deadly poison used by the Ninja Class - Nightshade Grove.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/fa1eb94ba75f109695996f4fdbe8e276d55e5bae.gif[/img]

Enjoy the scenery and discover the secret that lies within...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/9481c4d40563bf47a46f3cb48a71387af1d46bf5.png[/img]

[h2]Challenges[/h2]

Finally you'll be getting access to 6 new Challenges for the Ninja Class.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/ee5590ad9a23a78bcfba7eebadd7ba19c29d4ef0.png[/img]

Reach the highest reputation level with the legendary Archivist Clan and construct a build entierly from Soulflames, unlocking Skins and Legendary Talents along the way.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/767ee29959d4b8e5bc73ab6d50d69482d41dd2b9.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/4a9435e4bf36ead033128d6e47d30c0a87a9f78a.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/bd514ddf17fb9bf4fa06a65da1243e21de10ef58.gif[/img]

And there you have it! Lot's to be excited about whether you're booting the base game back up or trying out our 7th Class with the Wave of Shadows expansion.

We'll be keeping our ear to the ground for word of bugs/balance issues, so don't be shy with your feedback - also, watch this space for more information on what's next for us in the near future! Until then...

[i]Stay Talented[/i]

notes.title: Devlog #79 - Forbidden Digsite
notes.notes:
Hello Talented Gamers!

Just in case you missed it, our official [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=reRz46cWduI]Wave of Shadows Trailer[/url] has dropped and we're now full steam ahead for our release date of May 30th! If you haven't already you can wishlist Wave of Shadows here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3423250/Talented__Wave_of_Shadows/

Most of the systems and new content coming with the DLC has been announced at this point, but there's still a big feature left!

[h2]Cursed Relics[/h2]

In local playtests this has given him a lot more potential routes to power, without needing to rely entierly on Reload Speed Up.

[*] Helping Hands to 15% Activation Chance (up from 7% chance)
[*] Healing Hands, Mystic Hands and Rapid Hands talents to 10% Activation Chance (up from 7%)
[*] Fortunate Spree grants 20% Luck (up from 12%)
[*] Bargain Hunt now increases chance of Legendaries appearing in the shop if you have Black Market

[*] Work for Hire grants 15% Luck per combo Level (up from 10%)
[*] Pick Pocket has 20% Activation Chance (up from 5%)
[*] Smoke Trap now deals 8 damage (up from 3)

Having said that, the current Vision Distance was very limited and often made running into dead ends/unexpected disconnects easier than we would like. We've made some substantial changes here, so we're definitely interested in your thoughts!

notes.title: Devlog #75 - Riding the Wave
notes.notes:
Hello Talented Gamers!

Now the Alchemist Rework is live and our new [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3529280/Talented__Supporter_Pack]Supporter Pack[/url] is available (including 6 Shiny Colour skins!), we can continue chatting about the upcoming Wave of Shadows DLC!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3423250/Talented__Wave_of_Shadows/

The second major feature added with the DLC is the brand new Waves Mode - this is intended to be a different way to play Talented with all of your favourite classes... Let's take a look...

[h2]Waves Mode[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/60324c847d652f95ff4847bb8116079b4d6bc988.gif[/img]

Rather than the purely random spawns you're used to in Talented's Standard Run, this mode faces you against a sequence of Enemy Packs that are hand designed to test your build as you play.

These waves can be anything from a Googly spawning from each direction to an entire forest of Tronks and Treedle Twins each with random Elite Traits ploughing through the lane.

Each Wave consists of 5 Enemy Packs - only when you've survived all 5 are you able to progress to the Talent Tree and spend your hard earned Talent Points. After that it's off to another Wave...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/56592844ccb58f54eaec9496708678f19ef2a0a2.png[/img]

Fans of Talented's truly crazy builds will be happy to hear that Waves Mode is fully Endless from release, with difficulty scaling designed to test even maxed out builds. Additionally, whereas builds with an extremely high number of projectiles tend to shine in Standard Runs, many waves are designed to test other things such as damage with a single hit or even how much crowd control you have!

[h3]Special Enemy Packs[/h3]

As you progress through Waves Mode you will start to see Rare, then Epic, then Legendary... and even more types of Enemy Pack.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/1d451daa1fac2ea7225449a22511e85c0f7798b1.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/df33aa52621186884cff81cbfd5767ba35d46a65.png[/img]

Each increase in Rarity is not only a significant increase in raw difficulty, but also how specialised the challenge becomes. As the run heats up you'll start to see uniquely modified enemies and if you survive long enough you might even recieve and unwanted visit from a Boss Enemy!

[h3]Hexes[/h3]

In addition to the scaling difficulty of Enemy Packs, each run will apply up to 5 Hexes...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/24aa44bd268a448992b82f8cd50d9abd678f135c.png[/img]

These are permanent modifiers that will apply to all future encounters. As they appear less often than Curses in Standard runs they can afford to be far more impactful, they might even force you to adapt your build.

...And don't be caught off guard by that simple example... As the run progresses, later Hexes will be much more devilish.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/1f1d5d2d95dc0e622f78cb8dc08ec99ca916199e.png[/img]

[h3]Experience and Combo[/h3]

Particularly insightful gamers may have already identified that Experience and Combo cannot work in quite the same way in Waves Mode due to the varying number of enemies per Wave.

We're currently experimenting with solutions, but the one that appears to be coming out on top is giving each Enemy Pack a budget of Experience and Combo Points that is split evenly between each enemy in that Pack.

This means you'll get a consistent amount of experience whether you're fighting a horde of 100 Lil' Blobs or a giant boss.

[b]Note: [/b]All Experience Bonuses will apply to the Experience Budget, so they'll definitely still be worth picking up!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/bd514ddf17fb9bf4fa06a65da1243e21de10ef58.gif[/img]

Hopefully you like the direction we're moving in! There's still lots of surprises in store as we continue to expand both Ninja and Waves Mode so we may drop a few hints in future devlogs...

Next time I'll be showing an early version of the heavily requested Key Rebinding feature and we'll be dipping our toe into lava pool that is Mastery 30!

Stay tuned and...

We're aiming for some high impact changes that will bring Alchemist in line with the other classes in terms of fun factor. We can't wait to hear what you think!

[list]
[*] Forage has been reworked to give 2 random ingredients (instead of allowing you to pick 1 of 2)
[*] Forage is now slightly more common (but still less common than Forage and Cultivate combined)
[*] Cultivate has been replaced by Attack Speed Up

[h2]Other Balance[/h2]

notes.title: Devlog #73 - Returning to Alchemist
notes.notes:
Greetings Talented Gamers!

Now there's been plenty of time to look back on Talented's 1.0 release, we've collected all of the feedback both in the Steam Discussion Forums and our [url=https://discord.gg/sX3eCrvaJQ]Discord[/url] and Alchemist has stood out as not meeting your expectations for a Talented Class.

Alchemist was always the most experimental design. Combining Ability Crafting, Ingredient Gathering, Runes and the harsh limitation of absolutely no Basic Attack upgrade Talents.

There are many parts of Alchemist's core kit we are proud of and we're still confident in the variety offered by the Ability Crafting system (even if we understand that Charges can be frustrating sometimes) - but the way each of these components mesh together doesn't quite sit right with us...

...So we want to revisit this Class in a surprise Mini Update to the game coming before 1.1!

[h2]Alchemist Rework Time![/h2]

[b]So what are the main issues?[/b]

[list]
[*] Gathering Ingredient can be a tedious process and figuring out which ingredients to go for when can be unfun.
[*] Crafting Abilities can start interesting, but quickly becomes tedious - especially when you want to craft the same Potion over and over again.
[*] Having absolutely no way to improve your Basic Attacks means that at certain enemy health breakpoints, basic attacks suddenly cannot be relied upon. This means if you don't have enough ability charges, you become overwhelmed in a single day - this has always felt unfair. 
[*] The random nature in which most Runes spawn can often make them appear out of range of Abilities which can be extremely frustrating.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/186eb6185ad9fd23bd8e410732b66f6310475426.gif[/img]

[b]And what are we doing about it?[/b]

We're overhauling the way you gather ingredients. Instead of two different Ingredient Talents, there will be a single Forage Talent that grants two random Ingredients. This will mean easier access to ingredients overall and no more tedious selection of Ingredients as you traverse the tree.

The Alchemy Talent will now allow you to craft as many Potions Abilities as you like - you will even be able to craft multiple copies of the same potion at the same time. The tradeoff here is that Alchemy will appear on the tree less often (we're currently thinking around the same rate that Bandit's Shops appear).

We'll be adding some simple support for Alchemists Basic Attacks. This isn't intended to be a win condition in its own right, but should make the fall-off less sharp. For starters, Alchemist will now have access to the Attack Speed Up Talent.

We'll be reworking all of the Sigil Talents - instead of a % chance to Activate they will now require a number of enemy kills. Once that number is reached a Rune will appear in a random lane but, unlike the previous iteration, the Rune will always appear in a spot designed to be easily accessed by any Ability.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/579431ccfa924bf4556f0ece4ccc6e2908538582.gif[/img]

[h3]Other Changes[/h3]

The Mini Update will also fix a few of the more glaring issues with the 1.0 build. 

We know Divinity has been a bit of a run-ender in Endless Mode, so we'll be reducing its potency to bring it in line with the other Enemy Curses. We're also keenly aware of the Bandit Shop bug that causes Talents to have negative costs!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/94fc9168eda71bb2d49c18721a6ac67082f8c95b.gif[/img]

[h2]Supporter Pack[/h2]

Talented has always been a labour of love for everyone involved - we certainly didn't expect to reach the amazing audience we have and I know I am speaking for the whole team when I say the opportunity to continue making games and improving our craft is one we will always be grateful for.

Given the low price point, throughout the development of Talented we had the occasional request for an additional way to support the development team and the number of requests has substantially increased over the last few weeks. For this reason we've decided to begin work on a Supporter Pack!

The main purpose of this pack is to support our continued development of Talented and future projects, but it will include a unique Character Skin for each of the 6 original Classes and a special Thank You Note from the team. Keep an eye out for more information in a future update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/bd514ddf17fb9bf4fa06a65da1243e21de10ef58.gif[/img]

And that about covers it! The Mini Update should be on its way in the next few weeks, as with our Early Access updates we'll be uploading it to the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2435090/discussions/0/6273018183381089944/]Community Beta Branch[/url] to get as much feedback as we can before it goes live.

Next Devlog will be a return to more reveals for what's coming in the Wave of Shadows DLC, until then...

[i]Stay Talented[/i]

notes.title: Devlog #72 - From the Shadows
notes.notes:
Hello Talented Gamers!

We're deep in the development process for all of the upcoming features coming to Talented and it feels like the perfect time to announce our DLC!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/f9da8dcdfb002121d23ed5ba4db2e1e95e73889a.png[/img]
Wave of Shadows will be introducing our 7th Class along with a new mode, 6 new Challenges and an additional environment!

So.. I won't keep you waiting... Let's jump right in with the headline!

[h2]Ninja joins the Party...[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/c3bdb48fbb167ca17ed1ae8dfc7d541fdd90f1f5.png[/img]

You heard it here first, the 7th Class coming to Talented will be a Shuriken throwing, Soulflame unleashing, Talent Tree dashing assassin. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/2f8356b144bff1b06153a5b1d0efb479898f96b7.gif[/img]

As usual we've explored a number of new combat mechanics, the Ninja's basic attack will use the ammo system introduced with the Bandit. This time, however, a barrage of Shurikens (each dealing a small amount of damage) is released followed by a reload time. There will be a handful of ways to increase your clip size, making the barrage larger and larger!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/ed46f05df51b7d148eba89624a557f5511089eb6.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/64993358e0615f9342769f1659555798453edd3e.png[/img]

Couple this with Talents that synergise with tons of hits and you will be tearing your enemies apart in not time!

[h3]Soulflames[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/73211dae52d85aedcc49e211cf908539e4c17769.gif[/img]

Another new mechanic coming to Ninja is the Soulflame. A rapidly orbiting projectile that pierces enemies but only lasts for a fixed duration.

Unlike other Orbitals in the game, a healthy number of Soulflames will require constant upkeep and truly standout Soulflame builds will be allowed to break the usual cap of 50.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/812cb7a38e68c2b6e319e64c67b997fb796b34f6.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/1f199f2433d298561b81a979c740099453674b89.png[/img]

As with all things in Talented you'll be able to empower your Soulflames in a variety of ways, including the Starting Ability - Manifestation.

[h3]Prisms[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/f8d8fb16696914a567974cedbf1f99fa0ba29556.gif[/img]

While Ninja won't have access to the Attack Damage Up Talent, whenever a Shuriken passes through one of your Prisms, it will become enhanced - increasing its size and [b]doubling[/b] it's damage. 

Multiple Prisms keep doubling your damage, allowing your damage to quickly reach values with true oneshot potential. But that's not all...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/e61580ce82e3be054c71d2cbc3b0e8eb3072e27a.png[/img]

Enchanted Prisms will add extra effects to create some truly spicy Basic Attack synergies.

[h3]Navigation[/h3]

Another core part of Ninja's identity is Talent Tree rule bending in the form of mobility. We've explored this a few times in the past with Talents like Magical Hat, but Ninja will take it to a whole new level.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/58bc106e1e657b657ed205e1c58d27d4ae1dd243.png[/img]

You'll be leaping to the top of the tree in no time with Talents like this... Of course we want to keep some of the toys as a surprise for release, but I can reveal this nod to our other mobility Talents.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/9f50c0469aa51bc31fa22dbcc4b03d404f54ada1.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/bd514ddf17fb9bf4fa06a65da1243e21de10ef58.gif[/img]

...so those are a few of the things you can expect to encounter if you pick up the DLC early this year...

You may have noticed the suspicious absense of a resource like Magic Points or Charges... We'll be talking about exactly why that is next time! Until then...

[i]Stay Talented[/i]

notes.title: Devlog #71 - Keys to Victory
notes.notes:
Greetings Talented Gamers!

We're continuing to see an amazing response to the 1.0 release! Although we can't respond to every comment and post, we've loved seeing your broken builds and endless adventures. We're also keeping an eye out for bug reports and feedback as we develop our post-release plan.

This time I want to talk a bit about what will be coming in the 1.1 update (which will be released along side our upcoming DLC).

[h3]Key Rebinding[/h3]

Whether it's for a regional keyboard, accessibility or just because you don't like the keys we chose - we've heard you loud and clear! [b]Talented needs Key Rebinding![/b]

The 1.1 update will allow you to change all of the default bindings to anything you like. This will also have the positive side effect of having somewhere that each of our shortcuts are on show. (shout out to Hold R to restart run)

[h3]New Environment[/h3]

For all of Talented's history there has only been one Demonic Conveyor Belt. We certainly like how it looks, but we can definitely understand how playing 100s or even 1000s of run in the same environment can get old - so we'll be adding support for new Environments in the next update.

This will come with a brand new look available for anyone who has beaten the game on our original 6 Classes. We're experimenting with a few different styles at the moment, so we'll have more information on exactly what it looks like coming in a future Devlog.

[h3]Mastery 30[/h3]

Still hungry for more Challenge?

With the combined release of Endless Mode and our latest balance pass - it seems breaching Night 50 in Endless has become the true test of Talented skill (or luck depending who you ask!). With the 1.1 update we want to try and fold some more of the difficulty cap into the Standard 20 Night run while making sure it doesn't become about executing a perfect Night 1-5.

We'll be experimenting with new rules modifiers that push both combat and strategic skill further. These will come packaged with some balance changes aiming to broaden the number of viable strategies available to each class and deal with some pain points we've heard from your feedback.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/bd514ddf17fb9bf4fa06a65da1243e21de10ef58.gif[/img]

On top of everything mentioned above, we will be grouping up some bug fixes and QoL improvements to continue making Talented a better experience for everyone.

Once again, from the whole team, thank you so much for joining us on this journey and...

[i]Stay Talented[/i]

notes.title: Devlog #70 - A Special Thanks
notes.notes:
Greetings Talented Gamers!

1.0 has dropped and we're overwhelmed by how many amazing people have tried out our game, joined the community and gave us amazing feedback. 

It has been quite the launch, feedback has generally been positive but we were also hit with some fairly frustrating performance issues including a particularly nasty Endless Mode crash bug. We've already released 3 hotfixes to address the biggest problem causers and will keep an eye out for more feedback.

From everyone at the team, we want to give everyone a huge thanks - both for taking the time to try out the game in the first place, and being patient with our launch issues.

So! Let's talk about what's next for Talented!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/bd514ddf17fb9bf4fa06a65da1243e21de10ef58.gif[/img]

[h2]A New Update![/h2]

Work on our game won't stop just because 1.0 is released. We'll be releasing a 1.1 Update which will include a new feature, some new content and a handful of bug fixes, balance changes and quality of life improvements.

This won't be as large as our Early Access updates, but should give a few good reasons to boot the game back up - including a small collections of new Achievements.

You'll be hearing more about update 1.1 in our next Devlog (which we plan to continue every 2 weeks).

[h2]A DLC![/h2]

After the extremely positive response of Talented's release, I'm very proud to announce that we have begun early work on an expansion to the game.

We're exploring a lot of different potential ideas for new Core Features which I will reveal in due course but for now I can reveal it will include a brand new 7th Class with a unique way to obtain additional Talents.

As you'd expect this will be paid content, but rest assured there will be absolutely no purchasable power for the existing 6 Classes.

We're aiming to reveal more about the DLC in Spring 2025.

[h2]A New Game!?[/h2]

Finally, the biggest surprise of them all... We're working on a brand new game!

It's very early days but the plan is to keep some of the core elements of Talented and mix in new ideas and inspirations to make something that feels part of the same universe but distinctly new.

We might drop hints here and there but we're hoping to have an announcement before the end of Summer 2025.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/bd514ddf17fb9bf4fa06a65da1243e21de10ef58.gif[/img]

Whew! That was quite a lot all in one go. I cannot wait to share more detail about each of these things, and luckily the Devlog will be continuing so I'll get to do exactly that! Until then...

[i]Stay Talented[/i]

notes.notes:
Greetings Talented Gamers!

The time has finally come to release Talented into the wild in its full 1.0 glory. We're extremely thankful to everyone who followed the game through its development over the years from a weekend game jam to a game we're confident provides hours and hours of fun!

[b]The Compendium[/b]

All of Talented's major features can now be looked up in the Compendium.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/019248f278284c0e79e04dc5c39abcc7ae884b74.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/d2b843a404fa5ae72bc5fad4c1806c394def5de2.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/d9896545fbaf572dfce096e7f847e1b5bb08389f.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/72193bbffde47292b81a72270aed7af284fa24d3.gif[/img] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/40b347b825f5e918f509009b721d828f2ffa9faf.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/7a5f47aace833fa0635016c322731ba162af5347.gif[/img]

[b]Completionist[/b]

A handful of new Achievements are here to complete our full set of 160! Complete all of the challenges, defeat Mastery 25 on all Classes and unlock the full compendium to earn yourself the title of Talented Master.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/8fea480b54a10b332fac6ebc305337b6b5fe6d09.png[/img]

[b]Balance[/b]

[b][i]General[/i][/b]
[list]
[*] Feared now always slows enemy movement speed by 50%
[*] Confused now has 33% lower duration each time it is applied to the same enemy
[*] Metallic Portal now only makes you immune to damage for the first 30 seconds of the Night (down from the entire Night)
[*] Talent Packages can now appear 15% lower on the Talent Tree
[*] Added a cap to the additional Talent Tree vision distance provided by Talents and Portals of 100%. Farseer Portal will now grant 25% bonus experience if you can no longer gain vision distance
[/list]
[b][i]Wizard[/i][/b]
[i]As promised, this update contains large passes for the remaining 4 classes. When approaching Wizard we were generally happy with the number of viable strategies Wizard had, so we focussed on bringing up the power of those lagging behind and reducing that of the outliers. We also added some new twists to the lesser selected Packages (e.g. Cold As Ice) that should make them more appealing in a variety of late game buids.[/i]

[list]
[*] Ability Power Up Core Talent reduced to 40% (down from 50%)
[*] Deep Learning's Rare/Epic/Ability/Legendary Bonus Chance is increased to 35% (up from 10%)
[*] Cosmic Lance damage increased to 3 (up from 1)
[*] Arcane Wand has been added to the base package - Your Basic Attacks have an 10% chance to fire an additional Magic Bolt that applies deals an additional 3 x Ability Power Damage
[*] Arcane Orbs has been reworked to [Power Orb] - Create an Orb that permanently orbits you. Your Orbs deal 2 additional damage
[*] Rousing Knowledge has replaced Untamed Knowledge in the base package
[*] Full House has been reworked - Learn a random unlearnt Ability, If you've learnt 4 abilities your  the first time you cast each Ability each Night it is cast an additional time
[*] Untamed Knowledge has been moved to the Power Hungry Package as an epic with a 50% Activation Chance (up from 15%)
[*] Insight has been moved to the Outrageous Package and bonus experience increased to 20% (up from 15%)
[*] Power Creep has been reworked into an Epic in the Outrageous Package - Whenever you Critically Strike you gain 5% Ability Power until the end of the Night (up to 250%)
[*] Refractive Missile Activation Chance reduced to 35% (down from 50%)
[*] Gemmed Glove Activation Chance reduced to 10% (down from 12%)
[*] Surprise Factor reworked - The duration of Shocked and Wounded is increased by 10%
[*] Eureka! is now an epic Talent with a 35% Activation Chance (up from 10%)
[*] Intuition is now a rare Talent and affects your next 3 Rares (down from 5)
[*] Arcane Knowledge has been removed from the Power Hungry Package
[*] Flawless Execution has been changes to a Rare and now increases Ability Power by 40% (down from 100%)
[*] Crystal Orb has been renamed to Crystal Ball and no longer gives an Orb but the Bonus Experience is increased to 25% (up from 20%)
[*] If you have the maximum number of Orbs, Atomize will still duplicate a Special Orb (replacing a normal one with it)
[*] Orbular Knowledge has been replaced by Toxic Orb - Gain a Toxic Orb that applies decay to enemies it hits
[*] Orb Speed has been reduced by 25%
[*] Special Orbs (e.g. Glacial Orbs) now apply their special effect 50% of the time
[*] Super Effective's damage has been reduced to 2x Ability Power (down from 3x)
[*] Simple Interest now requires 2 unspent Talent Points (up from 1)
[*] Slightly randomized the drop location of meteors
[*] Meteor now has a cap of 10 active meteors at one time
[*] A new Talent, Expert Knowledge has replaced Thesis - Whenever you level up you have a 10% chance to Level Up an additional time
[*] A new Talent, Elemental Research has replaced Dissertation - Whenever you activate a Rare Talent you have a 50% chance to create an Elemental Sprite in a random lane (1 second cooldown)
[*] Royal Flush bonus experience reduced to 5% per Abilities (down from 10%)
[*] A new Ability, Conjure Weapon has replaced Studious in the Grind Em Up package - Create an enchanted staff in target direction that Attacks with 50% + (10% of Bonus Ability Power) of your Attack Speed for 10 seconds
[*] Ice Missiles has been reworked - Fire 4 Ice Missiles into random lanes that create a small explosion that deals 1 damage and applies Frostbite (Gain an additional Missile for every 10 Maximum Magic Points you have)
[*] Shatter has been reworked - Enemies that are Frostbitten have an additional 10% chance to be critically struck by Abilities (dealing 2x damage)
[*] Winter's Chill has been reworked - Frostbite slows by an additional 5% for every 20 Maximum Magic Points you have
[*] Wand Talents now have a 10% Chance to Activate (down from 12%)
[/list]
[b][i]Warrior[/i][/b]
[i]When approaching Warrior we came to realise there was quite a lot of work to do. Many of the Talent Packages felt subpar, attempting to create win conditions that would never really pay off. A lot of these packages just got in the way of the viable and fun ways to play Warrior, so we've doubled down on support for Throwing Weapons, defensive builds and size adding a ton more synergies. We've also added a few new tools to the Warrior toolbox.[/i]

[list]
[*] Tranquil Combo Health Regeneration rate reduced to 12% (down from 25%)
[*] Resistant Combo replaces Precise Combo in the Base Package 
[*] Killstreak Hunter replaces Victory Pose in the base Package
[*] Harsh Lesson is now an Epic that provides 100% Experience Points on Hit Taken/Parry (up from 25%), this replaces Grindstone
[*] Blood Pact is now in the Base Package (replacing Intimidating Strike)
[*] Blood Pact's Health Cost is reduced to 10 (down from 15)
[*] Blood Pact's Cooldown is reduced to 5 seconds (down from 8s)
[*] Thrown Around has been reworked into an epic that applies Confused to enemies knocked back further than 0.75 distance (instead of deal 1 damage)
[*] A new Rare Talent has been added to the Back and Forth Package [Hammers!] - Every 3 seconds you throw a Hammer in a random direction that deals 25 x Knockback Distance
[*] Relentless is now an Epic granting twice as many hits on Strike Abilities (up from +1)
[*] Victory Pose has been moved to the Strike Out Package
[*] Pure Brilliance now grants 5 random Common Talents (down from one of each Common Talent)
[*] Precise Combo has been moved to the Combo Package
[*] A new Rare Talent has been added to the Deflection Package [Ruthlessness] - Once per Night, if you reach Maximum Rage your Parry Chance is increased by 2% for every 10 Rage until the end of the Night
[*] Reflectium is now a Rare and deals 1 x Attack Damage to parried enemies (down from 2x)
[*] A new Rare Talent has been added to the Get Back Up Package [Rejuvinate] - When you Regenerate Health Points you gain 5 kills on the Combo Meter
[*] A new Ability has been added to the Get Back Up Package [Flesh Pact] - Sacrifice 10 Health Points to gain 10% Size until the end of the Night (This effect will not break your current Combo)
[*] Defiant Stance has been changed to an Epic replacing Nature Unleashed in the Get Back Up Package. Health Requirement is reduced to 25% (down from 30%), Parry Chance is increased to 30% (up from 10%)
[*] Most Throwing Weapons now Activate every 4 seconds (up from 3s)
[*] Daggers! now have a 50% chance to Critically Strike (down from 100%)
[*] Spears! is now an Epic Talent that and throws 2 Spears (up from 1)
[*] Armoury bonus Throwing Weapon damage reduced to 10% (down from 25%)
[*] A new Ability has been added to the Throwing Weapons Package [Forge] - Throw a random Throwing Weapon in each direction, if you have at least 10 Throwing Weapon Talents/Abilities you throw another 2
[*] Megalophobia is now an Epic and gives a base 10% chance to fear approaching enemies (up from 4%)
[*] A new Rare Talent has been added to the In Charge Package [Onslaught] - Killing an enemy at least 3.5 range from you grants 2% Attack Speed until the end of the Night (up to 16%)
[*] Intimidating Strike replaces War Cry in the Horror Package
[*] A new Epic replaces Despair in the Horror Package [Cull the Weak] - Feared enemies give five kills on the Combo Meter
[*] On Point Attack Damage per stack increased to 2 (up from 1), Maximum Attack Damage increased to 6 (up from 5)
[*] Unbound Power now gives 5 additional Maximum Rage
[*] Earthquake's Knockback Distance has been reduced by 25%
[*] Well Aged has been reworked to - You gain 5% Bonus Experience for every 10 Maximum Health you have
[*] Mountain's Health Regeneration Rate Increase has been reduced to 25% (down from 30%)
[/list]
[b][i]Bandit[/i][/b]
[i]Generally speaking we're happy with where Bandit fell after the most recent changes to the Shop system. Instead of fixing what isn't broken, we've stuck to moving a few gameplay elements around and introduced some new support for Ability win conditions to help bring those in line with other, more prevalent strategies.[/i]

[list]
[*] The Activation Chance of all rounds Talents has been reduced to 15% (down from 25%)
[*] Initial Reload Time increased to 1.9 seconds (up from 1.75s)
[*] Critical Timing is replaced by a new Epic in the Core Talents [Liquid Assets] - The Ability in your first slot has its cooldown reduced by 35%
[*] Big Blind has been moved to the Base Package and replaces Top Dollar
[*] Savage Spree has been moved to the Base Package, replacing Hole in One
[*] Hole in One has been moved to the Agile Investment Package
[*] Lethal Spree has been moved to the Agile Investment Package
[*] Haggle has been moved to the Investment Package
[*] A new Rare Talent has been added to the Investment Package [Sniping Spree] - Whenever you enter a Shop you gain 0.15 Range until the end of the next Night
[*] Spending Spree has been moved to the Serial Spender Package
[*] A new Ability has been added to the Serial Spender Package [Deposit] - Fire 2 Treasures in random directions that deal 10 damage (Entering a Shop increases the number of Treasures fired up to 50)
[*] Club Card has been reworked - Gain 25 Gold. Learn a random Cash Out Talent somewhere on the Talent Tree
[*] Eyes on the Prize now grants a 5th Ability Slot if you do not have one already
[*] Top Dollar has been moved to the Refurbish Package
[*] Work For Hire now grants 10% Bonus Luck per Combo Level (up from 5%)
[*] New Hotness is now an Epic Talent and give 25% chance to activate Spree Talents on shop reroll (up from 10%)
[*] A new Rare Talent has been added to the Bluff Package [Enkindled Weapon] - Reload Speed is increased by 25% for 4 seconds whenever you use an ability
[/list]
[b][i]Alchemist[/i][/b]
[i]This was the most experimental class in Talented... I'll be doing a deeper dive into what we're happy and unhappy with in a future post, but needless to say Alchemist has been devisive. We're aware of the mixed feelings about limited resources and how Forage/Cultivate can feel like useless Talents in the late game but we've opted to stick with our original vision for the class and learn from it. We're still confident in the crafting mechanic and we're much happier with Runes after the rework last update so we still think there's a lot worth coming back to the class for.

Having said that we're still quite a bit we want to iterate on before releasing him into the wild. Many of the Potion Abilities felt weak and lots of the 3rd/4th ingredient options felt overly complex. We also didn't feel Throwing Weapons had enough support to be a viable win condition.[/i]

[list]
[*] Ice Nova gives 20% range (Instead of dealing additional damage to Frostbitten enemies)
[*] Arcane Nova Cooldown Reduction on kill increased to 1s (up from 0.5s)
[*] Sanguine Nova damage increased to 3 (up from 2)
[*] Vampiric Bolt to 100% Heal Chance (up from 40%)
[*] Flame Bolt now pierces Burning enemies (instead of dealing double damage to them)
[*] Volcanic Wave damage increased to 15 base (up from 10)
[*] Volcanic Wave damage reduction per hit increased to 3 (up from 2)
[*] Astral Wave now deals 2 damage when moving out and 5 on return (instead of 3 each way)
[*] Crimson Wave damage increased to 10 (up from 8)
[*] Crimson Wave now restores 5 HP if it kills at least 2 enemies
[*] Volatile (gained from a 3rd Cinderoot) now grants - This Ability has a 50% Critical Strike chance
[*] Rushing (gained from a 3rd Bubblebloom) now grants - This Ability applies a random Status Effect
[*] Impaling (gained from a 3rd Bloodthistle has been reworked to - [Rending] When this Ability kills an enemy they grant 50% additional experience
[*] of Potency (gained from a 4th Cinderoot) now increases Ability damage by 50% (instead of a flat 4 damage)
[*] of Demise (gained from a 4th Bloodthistle) no longer applies Wounded when Decay is already applied
[*] All Runes now detonate 2 times (down from 3)
[*] Potions! Ability Power scaling reduced to 2x (down from 3x)
[*] Refine's Experience Bonus reduced to 2% per activation (down from 5%)
[*] Refine now has a cap on Experience Bonus of 20%
[*] Revitalise Bonus Ability Power reduced to 8% per activation (down from 10%)
[*] Revitalise now has a cap on Ability Power of 80%
[*] Abundance additional Potion Charges increased to 5 (from 4)
[*] Four of a Kind has been replaced by [Cauldrons!] - Every 5 seconds you throw a Flask in a random direction that deals 3x Ability Power Damage, if it kills the enemy they turn into a random Loot Item
[*] Artisan Ability Power per Potion Craft reduced to 20% (down from 25%)
[*] Replenish Activation chance reduced to 20% (down from 25%)
[*] Deep Roots additional damage increased to 2 per second (up from 1 per second)
[*] Deep Roots maximum damage increased to 10 (up from 5)
[*] Communication Skills has been reworked to - Whenever you detonate a rune you gain 5% Ability Power until the end of the Night 250%
[*] Communication Skills replaces Archaeologist in the base package
[*] Archaeologist has been moved to the Rock and Stone package
[*] Curiosity is now a Rare Talent and grants - Whenever you detonate a Rune you gain 2% Experience Bonus until the end of the Night (up to 20%)
[*] Books! is now an Epic Talent and grants - Every 10 seconds you throw a Book in a random direction that deals damage equal to your Level, kills with Books grant double Experience Points
[*] Farmer Talents now give a random ingredient other than the one that Activates them (instead of an additiona ingredient you already have)
[*] The Activation Chance of all Farmer Talents is increased to 12% (up from 10%)
[*] Thistle Whistle now also gives Scarlet Lance an additional 30% range
[*] Retrace has been replaced by a new Talent [Chakrams!] - Every 5 seconds you throw a Gem in a random direction that deals 3 + (1 x Abilities used this Night)
[*] Scavange has been replaced by a new Talent [Scepters!] - Every 5 seconds you throw a Gem in a random direction that deals 3 + (1 x Items Looted this Night) damage
[*] Rousing Knowledge now grants 10% Ability Power on Level Up (up from 5%)
[*] Rousing Knowledge now has a 100% Ability Power Cap
[*] Pitcher time between Throwing Weapons reduction reduced to 8% (down from 10%)
[*] Ace now has a 25% chance to throw an additional Throwing Weapon (down from 100%)

[/list]
[b][i]Challenges[/i][/b]
[list]
[*] The Arms Race Challenge now unlocks at Mastery 20 (up from Mastery 15)
[*] The Archer's Zombies! Challenge now unlocks at Mastery 25 (up from Mastery 20)
[*] Sharp Shooter reward changed to a new Robot Skin
[*] Investor Reward Changed to Diamond Rounds Legendary Talent
