notes.title: Devlog #51 - Nightmare Fuel
notes.notes:
Greetings Talented Gamers!

We're closing in fast on the 0.12 update, this should hopefully be the final devlog before it drops. As always, there will be a round of balance changes and bug fixes which you can find in the release notes.

This week I'll dive into the minor features that will be coming with the update, special thanks to our Beta Testers who've been giving feedback on these (and helping us spot all of the bugs!).

[b]Damage Numbers[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/b30fdd7b73dd61e231b788140d11b67ed167bcbe.gif[/img]

By popular request, Damage Numbers can now be enabled in the settings menu! Time to find out just how much damage you're dealing with your 10,000% Ability Power.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/5ac1dca825a99ab47a959a72e30ca6104565f0c5.gif[/img]

The larger the damage dealt, the bigger the number!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/618703c42ec9c9aef821d224505cd7701a818698.gif[/img]

And crits even have their own special funky style!

[b]Eternal Nightmare[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/fbd922b12ea659bd25e65c235003c179c79b69b0.gif[/img]

Now this one we're really exited about - at Mastery 10 you can now unlock the new Eternal Nightmare Game Mode. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/fad18a7989be39296a1b48dc36a4929fcbde4e86.png[/img]

You can enter the Nightmare by completing any run on Mastery 10+. When you do, you'll be granted with an endless Night that steadily increases in difficulty until the entire screen is a wall of enemies!

There are 3 achievements for surviving 30, 90 and 180 seconds and you can find your best survival time on the Character Selection Bridge. We've been loving this one in our playtests!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/e72307038279fc679ec46fffe22a1e1f979ab433.png[/img]

[b]Lock 'n' Load[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/12895d8d42f67087fd86750fc17fb28e94b84dba.png[/img]

We're rebalancing Bandit this update to be slightly less Shop reliant. The full list of changes will be in the release notes but [b]Spoiler Alert:[/b] Shop Prices of Ability, Epic and Legendary Talents will be going up drastically.

To help ease the blow we'll be allowing you to lock Talents in the Shop, so you can hold onto them for a later time when you have more cash!

[b]'Chieves[/b]

As always we'll be going out with a batch of 20 new Achievements. These come in all shapes and sizes, here's a couple of our faves:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/463cf4de524635d357a7e1aca9299afa04b62100.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/a0666fe06acc90aa248157f4008d9862a57b7198.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/e6ac1d5a09277e68d6779b2525717062452ad32f.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/bd514ddf17fb9bf4fa06a65da1243e21de10ef58.gif[/img]

So there you have it, we can't wait to see what everyone thinks of all of our hard work on this update! As always we'd love to hear your thoughts, both in the comments here and on our [url=https://discord.gg/uKYJ2uanZF]Discord[/url]. 

We do our best to read everything, even if we can't respond. Until next time...

[i]Stay Talented[/i]

notes.title: Devlog #50 - The Best Boi
notes.notes:
Hello Talented Gamers!

DEVLOG 50! WE MADE IT!

I want to give a massive thank you to anyone who has taken the time to read these, we certainly didn't expect to keep them going as long as we have!

This time we'll be revealing some of the new Talents that will be bursting onto the tree with the 0.12 update for Warrior, Summoner and Bandit! If you didn't catch last devlog and want to know more about how Talent Packages are being reworked and what Archer and Wizard have to look forward to, you can find that [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2435090/view/4030227738310051923?l=english]here[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/b583d26237c19d3bb4fc89671ba50f3ab0658932.gif[/img]

[b]Curveball[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/119638c48fe41be99653fd1c629918f7cc3941fb.gif[/img]

Warrior will be chucking some shiny new weapons in 0.12.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/c502eca24863f51c70177c7e18988566dbfded58.png[/img]

Throwing Weapons come from a handful of different sources. New Talents allow you to throw them every few seconds, New Abilities will let you throw them on command and the Axes from [b]Axe Toss[/b] also count as Thrown Weapons. 

With Talents from the [b]Fastball[/b] Talent Package you'll be able to build around Throwing Weapons even further!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/1ed4b46bb96ef162a3a2fbfd657971a5fb544719.png[/img]

[b]Friends Til the End[/b]

Summoner is getting his most loyal summon yet!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/22c46425767aa397043a78771a5f50ff80b1a521.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/ed396a1d74b8aef57ae3b95323fe246ac8fe699f.png[/img]

Once you've summoned the Ghost Puppy, he'll keep returning to you until the end of the Night - even if he dies! Remember that a pet is for life though, every dog deserves a healthy diet and a cute collar!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/3439287b725816bf478b7ac84a9c119c18e1e720.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/c48251bbc8c86646fb5b728fa6c1380d96e320c1.png[/img]

[b]Shop Til you Drop[/b]

We're building out Bandit's identity further in 0.12 by giving him some new mechanics core to his class.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/0576a00a7330ad98acd730583021709ad73f2970.png[/img]

Spree Talents will reward you for entering the Shop, these buffs can get pretty out of control if you enter the Shop multiple times in a single Night...

Lucky for you we'll be adding even more ways to do that!  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/29cb17522da70567df02e489dbfcb618865f40b4.png[/img]

We're also experimenting with Talent Packages giving classes access to mechanics usually reserved for other classes. Some clever people already made the connection between Wizard's Elementals and Summoner's Helpers! 

Bandit is next in line, receiving a Combo Package in 0.12.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/bdb50774a26f3988fde74e0879554cb3926909fd.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/f3c0d8e5cf7e10a8e2a388a09909c682b2f4b981.png[/img]

Our goal with any class getting Talent Packages that use a mechanic from another class is to make sure:

- They feel like they're accessing that mechanic in a unique way that's on-brand for the class
- They're never the "master" of that mechanic in the same way the class that owns it is (Bandit should never get combo benefits as powerful as Warrior!)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/bd514ddf17fb9bf4fa06a65da1243e21de10ef58.gif[/img]

Of course that's only a sneak peek at the Talent Packages coming next update, there are plenty more we haven't revealed yet. We can't wait to see what you make of them when the update drops.

Thank you so much for joining us for the 50th Devlog and double thanks if you've been reading for a while! Next time we'll be revealing the new Endless Nightmare feature and will hopefully be ready to show off some Damage Numbers. Until then...

[i]Stay Talented[/i]

notes.title: Devlog #49 - Re-Packaged
notes.notes:
Hello Talented Gamers!

We're moving swiftly on to our second major feature of patch 0.12 - Talent Packages 2.0!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/1b1c11c64f83e98dcb9b2d3035b7653aa404aaa3.png[/img]

After hearing a ton of feedback on how the old system worked, we've reworked this feature from the ground up. The main points we want to hit are:

[list]
[*] Give you more influence over which Talent Packages appear on the tree.
[*] Give you more opportunities for unique builds.
[/list]
Discovery Talents can now be found on the Talent Tree giving you a choice of 3 random Talent Packages to choose from.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/731edb4dca7a47c4c05a088493ec8647aa416eb1.png[/img]

When you make a choice, that Package will then take over the surrounding area, swapping unlearnt Common Talents with Rares and unlearnt Rares with Epics/Abilities.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/b583d26237c19d3bb4fc89671ba50f3ab0658932.gif[/img]

Discovery Talents will appear at a similar rate to Epic Talents but start to show up slightly higher on the tree. This does mean you'll finally be able to access more than 2 Talent Packages in a single run!

[b]New Stuff[/b]

Of course we can't update the new Talent Package system and not give you some new toys to play with! This week I'll reveal some of the new mechanics that Archer and Wizard will be getting.

[i]Having a Blast[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/c17219ebdcf085c79097e1235c503926afd60ea0.gif[/img]

Archer will be getting some extra firepower in the form of Homing Missiles. These cheeky chappys seek out the nearest enemy and deal 50% of your Attack Damage on impact, they can be deadly in large numbers. 

There will be plenty of ways to fill the screen with them, but here's a couple to get your started.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/4a62a92008ed5f217fd2d9fe32bd2506f8c2633f.png[/img]

And of course, like anything it Talented - you can upgrade it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/87e51aea621fe51b10083b16fedb59d9ae6eddad.png[/img]

[i]Helpers...? On Wizard...?[/i]

Wizard will be getting something far more sensible (I'm kidding).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/3fb4104050ba2caa04c972c9ff0ee824408dfd4e.gif[/img]

Introducing Elementals - these fun little friends will be summoned through a variety of Talents and Abilities.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/26db45df1ef0c30eee33b47f5627e24c8426f175.png[/img]

Elementals can be Fire, Wind, Earth or Frost and each of them applies a Status Effect (Burning, Shocked, Wounded and Frostbite in that order). Once you've got them, you'll be on the hunt for ways to make them even more powerful.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/bb133fea6282bfac5394f937373f63b471499fc4.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/bd514ddf17fb9bf4fa06a65da1243e21de10ef58.gif[/img]

There are even more Talent Packages for our other 3 classes to reveal next time - so keep your googlys peeled for more news! Until then...

[i]Stay Talented[/i]

notes.title: Devlog #48 - Skintimidation
notes.notes:
Hello Talented Gamers!

We've been hard at work developing the first major feature of 0.12 - our Challenge system - and there's so much to share! 

As mentioned in our original announcement, each class with be getting 3 challenges just for them (totaling 15). Challenges are intended to be a twist on the classic Talented gameplay that either pushes a certain playstyle to the extreme or gives you something entirely unique.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/19d7c30cd1fb0458179e2d060fad17ea310701c0.png[/img]

A nod to some of our favorite games and a commonly requested feature. You can finally be the turret you were born to be!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/948ed12c415527f31a2d61ef5304f56f261263d5.png[/img]

Ever wonder what Talented would be like if you just had [b]EVERYTHING[/b]?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/099aa6e3554287694f8f313e6ed47f9e1a1240e7.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/5fab55cb48359c4321177fc36cf51b39210bf6fb.gif[/img]

Everyone wanted a Talented babysitter mode, right?

[b]Rewards[/b]

Better yet! You won't just be playing for pride, each challenge rewards either a Legendary Talent unlock for that class, or a skin.

0.12 will have 5 Legendary Talents and [b]10 SKINS[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/a6c4ab6f5cabb6e3ff1009941a36c5f66bc7a01b.gif[/img]

We always felt bad about adding the 0.1 second Time Between Attacks cap, so we've let you demolish that!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/17987e9e3c39395b74405505a568432b5fde3afc.png[/img]

Each skin comes with some very small adjustments to base stats (and perhaps the occasional custom mechanic). These are mostly intended to add a little bit of flavor, but I'm sure some people will have fun min-maxing...

Challenges should be dropping on our Community Beta Branch very soon, if you're interested in helping us improve this and even more features you can check out the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2435090/discussions/0/6273018183381089944/]Beta Tester program Here[/url]! We'd love to have you.

[b]More Balance[/b]

We've also been working with our Beta Testers to fix some balance outliers in the 0.11 update, with a particular focus on Bandit (since he's our newest character).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/6d38de198ce3306ed7eace6a4ab071bbfd95163a.png[/img]

We tried a few different versions of Mining Operation before setting on this one, it should keep the feeling of a growing (and potentially infinite) economy but be a little less game breaking.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/7a597c10e26ec903b1e1ba22516ba3ef50df1318.png[/img]

We felt both Bladed Round and Fireworks rounds were underwhelming compared to other rares, so they've been brought up to speed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/d887cb12d3230c3f98c7e8bdf90032b3f5224032.png[/img]

Axe Toss has felt like the inferior Warrior starting ability for quite some time. Not only have we buffed the base ability, but his Level 12 upgrades should be much more appealing now too

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/afaa270b8a801d20a415b5b7a1fa5b03254220f5.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/6dffb60aeb085ff45734542e8ab96416ce4cb584.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/bd514ddf17fb9bf4fa06a65da1243e21de10ef58.gif[/img]

That should be plenty to chew on this time! Next Devlog I will be diving into the changes to Talent Packages and hopefully revealing some of the new Talents you can unlock.

[i]Stay Talented[/i]

notes.title: Devlog #47 - Rise to the Challenge
notes.notes:
Hello Talented Gamers!

We hope you're enjoying 0.11, especially after the hotfixes that should bring Archer and Bandit up to scratch and fix that pesky Orbs bug. But enough about the past - new update, new me!

[b]Challenges[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/88af9b578509535417f8d6eceecb247308d1fee9.png[/img]

It's our first major feature of 0.12! Challenges will offer a variety of ways to play each of your favorite classes each with their own set of custom rules designed to provide a unique problem to solve.

Next update will contain 15 Challenges in total (3 for each Class) and all of these will have their own completion reward!

Next Devlog will be a deep dive into the Challenges System and the rewards you can expect, so keep an eye out for that.

[b]Re-Packaging[/b]

This is going to be a huge update for Talent Packages! Every Class will be getting some new toys to play with and we'll be paying special attention to the Bandit as has some catching up to do in the Talent Count department.

If all goes as planned we should cross over the 300 Talent mark in this update!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/186eb6185ad9fd23bd8e410732b66f6310475426.gif[/img]

When it comes to how Talent Packages are added to the run, things have always felt off. As we mentioned in a previous devlog, the reroll button was only a short term solution for selecting Talent Packages. 

0.12 will contain a complete refactor for how the Packages are chosen and added to the tree. We've listened closely and we want to make sure you have the opportunity to influence which packages are chosen [b]but also[/b] want opportunities to find unique builds.

How will we make that happen? - Find out in a future devlog!

[b]More Stuff![/b]

We'll also be throwing in some additional minor features, some of which have been requested in the Steam Discussion forums and our Discord server (do keep that feedback rolling in!)

[i][b]Eternal Nightmare[/b][/i] - A new way to truly put your build to the test after you've completed a run. ([b]Note:[/b] This is not Endless Mode, but should help scratch that itch for now!)

[i][b]Optional Damage Numbers[/b][/i] - Pew-Pew Number Big

[i][b]Core Talents Update[/b][/i] - Some larger scope balance changes are coming to Core Talents... More on this later.

[b][i]20 New Achievements[/i][/b] - New content means new ways to break the game - and in Talented you get rewarded for it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/bd514ddf17fb9bf4fa06a65da1243e21de10ef58.gif[/img]

And of course there will be the usual Quality of Life changes, bug fixes and balance changes that every update contains! Looking forward to diving into the details with you all next time...

[i]Stay Talented[/i]

notes.title: Price Increase on 16/1
notes.notes:
Hello Talented Gamers!

As mentioned in devlog #46, we will be increasing the price of Talented 1 week after 0.11's release which will be tomorrow. This gives you one final day to get Talented at its current price before it increases to $2.99 (USD) with prices in other regions determined by Steam's price recommendation.

Our original plan was to increase the price with the release of 0.11 but add a week long sale where it would be available at the old price. Unfortunately when we went to do that we discovered that you cannot put a game on sale within 30 days of upping the cost (which makes sense in hindsight!).

We've been told more times than we can count that we could be charging more for all of the content we offer, so I really want to thank everyone in the community for giving us the confidence to do this. Hopefully our continued dedication to making Talented as good as it can be will go some of the way to repaying you.

[i]Stay Talented[/i]

notes.title: Hotfix 0.11.50
notes.notes:
First things first - The bug where Orbs would sometimes disappear until you gained more is fixed. Very sorry for that one!

Archer was feeling weak to the point of unfun on higher Mastery Levels with a lot of his Rare Talents feeling underpowered. We've given him real boost.

[list]
[*] Archer base Range increased to 3.20 (from 3.0)
[*] Archer base Time Between Attacks reduced to 0.9s (down from 1.0s)
[*] Quick Fire base Cooldown reduced to 12s (down from 15s)
[*] Explosive Traps Max Charges increased to 3 (up from 2)
[*] Frost Traps Max Charges increased to 3 (up from 2)
[*] Field Research Experience increase increased to 4% (up from 2%)
[*] All Rare Collector Talents now have a 3% drop rate (up from 2%)
[*] Liqourice Collector drop rate increased to 5% (up from 4%)
[*] All Rare Bounty Talents require 15 kills (down from 25)
[*] Savage Bounty and Brutal Bounty now refresh their buff duration instead of applying multiple buffs if they are already in progress (multiple versions of the same Talent still apply multiple buffs)
[*] Bountiful Bounty now requires 30 kills (down from 50)
[*] Bountiful Bounty Experience Granted reduced by 20%
[*] Inside Scoop now reduces Bounty requirements by 3 (down from 5)
[*] Minimum Bounty Requirement reduced to 5 (down from 10)

The Talent economy was getting pretty out of control, especially on Wizard! We've made some minor adjustments to keep a bit more of a lid on it in those especially OP runs.

[*] Talented Combo XP Bonus reduced to 100% (down from 125%)
[*] Truly Talented Combo XP Bonus reduced to 150% (down from 200%)
[*] Increased the Experience required to gain a Level by 10% for every 50 levels (This is a 10% increase on the previous value, and should only really be felt on very high levels)
[/list]

We will revisit the Talent economy more in 0.12.

[i]Stay Talented[/i]

notes.title: Talented 0.11 Update - Legendary Investment
notes.notes:
Hello my Legendary Bandits!

It's update time, and OH BOY is there a lot to talk about. There should even be some surprises for those who've kept up to date with all of the devlogs. Let's dig in...

[b]New Class - Bandit[/b]

Our first new Class in quite some time, and he sure does have [i]class[/i]...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/435b34b9b4c6d7b1e76a4b780c39bad139a009bd.png[/img]

[i][b]Cash Money[/b][/i]

The Bandit will have access to a new resource - [b]Gold Coins[/b] and a new stat - [b]Luck[/b]. Luck will affect your percentage change for enemies to drop a Gold Coin upon death. 

Luck can be increased by learning the Common [Luck Up] Talents

[i][b]Hold Your Fire[/b][/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/7c862d33294885b9c8694cf605c1746f6f85c16d.gif[/img]

The Bandit has a higher base attack speed and his basic attacks fire two shots. However, he will have to reload when out of ammo. 

[i][b]Big Spender[/b][/i]

You can spend your Gold Coins that may drop from enemies on your abilities. Make the choice, will you spend all your coins defeating enemies, or will you save it for the...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/4875c69975f1e0f48950f53e00562088d4490750.png[/img]

A new Talent can be found on the tree - [b]Cash Out [/b]. Once bought, a shop will open and you can spend your Gold Coins on Common and Rare Talents, and even abilities and epics if you're lucky. 

[b]Legendary Gamer Moment[/b]

Legendary Talents have been added to the Talent Tree. These Talents will be available on the tree extremely rarely (usually no more than once per run), and will cost more Talent Points than any other. In the right build they will be game breaking, but they're designed to also find a useful home in your build.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/60d23c4cd5444aab4e9c0c67ba23e6faddc4aaa3.gif[/img]

[b]RNG Pooling[/b]

We have reworked how Talents generate in the Talent Tree. Instead of Talents being pulled at random from the total pool of Talents, when the Talent Tree is created at the start of a run, Common Talents will fill a pool. Whenever a Common Talent is placed on the tree, it will be removed from the pool. When the pool is empty, it will refill completely again.  

Some Common Talents will appear multiple times in a single pool. (e.g. Attack Speed Up will appear 4 times in a pool for Archer, whereas Damage Up will appear only once). 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/3bac7b8ea1bc2a97eb4829b4b5f1584dd4828d9e.png[/img]

This change should mean Common Talents will appear more evenly spread throughout the Talent Tree. Rare Talents, Abilities, Enemy Spawns and Enemy Wave Sizes will all use this pooling system also. 

[b]Combo Rework[/b]

[i][b]New Combo Levels[/b][/i]

Two new Combo Levels have been added, and the number of kills needed to achieve the levels have been adjusted. 
[list]
[*] [Skilled] (+10% XP) - 20 Kills
[*] [Gifted] (+25% XP) - 50 Kills
[*] [Brilliant] (+50% XP) - 100 Kills
[*] [Masterful] (+85% XP) - 250 Kills
[*] [Talented] (+125% XP) - 500 Kills
[*] [Truly Talented] (+200% XP) - 1000 Kills
[/list]
[i][b]Combo Doesn't Completely Reset[/b][/i]

We have also adjusted the Combo Meter penalty for getting hit. Instead of completely losing your Combo if you get hit, you will now be demoted to the previous Combo Level. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/186eb6185ad9fd23bd8e410732b66f6310475426.gif[/img]

[b]Minor Features[/b]

We've been monitoring the Discord and Steam Discussion forums closely and have hand picked some much requested Quality of Life features for this update. We'll be continuing to add even more in 0.12 so do keep that feedback rolling in!

[list]
[*] Added a button to allow Talent Packages to be rerolled on the Run Setup Screen
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/0e4802bdf47897fbfeb045cf92b3eeaa9f3a3f87.png[/img]
[*] Added a bonus Mastery Level unlock if a run is completed with fewer than 5 hits taken
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/51e2c2a2555a799ab21c29e8cbc7a9774ab71d28.png[/img]
[*] 20 brand new achievements have been added
[*] Added a setting to permanently keep the Stats Panel open
[*] Added a tooltip showing the current and maximum Health/Resource quantities
[*] Added Retry and Next Mastery buttons to the run end screen
[*] Added combat stats for Character Size, Shots Per Basic Attack, Orb Damage and Orb Count to the Stats Panel
[*] Added the current night you are on to the Clock in the Top Right
[*] Added a warning popup when exiting a run that explains progress will be lost
[*] Added a warning popup when save data is corrupted giving the option to reset or exit the game (so it can be reported to us!)
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/bd514ddf17fb9bf4fa06a65da1243e21de10ef58.gif[/img]

[b]Class Balance[/b]

Each Class is getting their own set of major changes this update. We've been paying close attention to player feedback and doing many, many playtests of our own. Hopefully this should be a step in the right direction of all of our Classes, but do not fear, there will be a lot more to come in the future!

[i][b]General Balance[/b][/i]
[list]
[*] 1UP has been reworked into [b][Safety Mush][/b] - You gain 0.25 Knockback distance and an extra life, ressurecting with 50% health points and instantly killing all enemies after death
[*] D6 has been reworked into [b][D6][/b] - Rerolls all nearby unlearnt Common Talents into Rare Talents
[*] The One Ring has been reworked into [b][The One Ring][/b] - Gain one of every Common Talent
[*] MP Regeneration Up Talents now increase MP Regeneration by 12% (up from 10%)
[*] Range Up Talents now increase Range by 0.15 (up from 0.1)
[*] Mastery 8 (Talent Tree Vision Range Down) has been replaced with [More Enemies]
[*] Mastery 15 (Talent Tree Vision Range Down) has been replaced with [More Enemies]
[*] Mastery 22 (Talent Tree Vision Range Down) has been replaced with [Larger Enemies]
[*] All Classes now have a minimum Time Between Attacks/Summons of 0.1 seconds
[*] Reduced the distance from the player that Smushrooms begin focusing
[*] Smushrooms are no longer knocked back when hit while focusing
[/list]
[i][b]Archer[/b][/i]
[list]
[*] Piercing Blows has been removed (See Hole in One and Spectral Quiver)
[*] Twin Strike has been removed (See Invoked Weapon)
[*] Archer can now learn [b][Hole In One][/b] (Epic) - You gain 5% Critical Strike Chance. Whenever you Critically Strike and enemy, your attack pierces through them and hits an additional target
[*] Archer can now learn [b][Spectral Quiver][/b] (Rare) - Your basic attacks have a 5% chance to pierce through an additional target
[*] Archer can now learn [b][Invoked Weapon][/b] (Epic) - Basic Attacks fire an additional arrow for 2 seconds whenever you use an Ability
[*] Gust Quiver now fires an additional Orbital Arrow when it activates (instead of making a shot orbital)
[*] Core Talent Unburdened has been replaced by [b][Field Research][/b] - Each time you use an ability, you gain 2% Experience until the end of the Night
[*] All Quiver talents have a 8% chance to proc (up from 3%)
[*] Gumballs now increase Attack Speed by 3% (down from 5%)
[*] Enchanted Weapon and Charmed Weapon's buff is now extended when additional Abilities are used while they are active, instead of applying multiple times
[*] Enchanted Weapon now increases Attack Speed by 25% (up from 10%)
[*] Charmed Weapon now increases Critical Strike Chance by 10% (up from 5%)
[*] Three Hit Mechanic now grants double Attack Damage every third attack (instead of a guaranteed critical strike)
[*] Duplication Hack now has a 50% chance to duplicate a piece of loot when it drops (down from 100%)
[*] Cold Streak now grants 10% crit per non-crit (up from 1%)
[*] The Forbidden Harvest Package now contains [b][Savage Bounty][/b] (Rare) - Killing 25 enemies grants 15% Attack Speed for 5 seconds
[*] Explosive Trap's cooldown has been reduced to 6 seconds (from 10 seconds)
[*] Frost Trap's cooldown has been reduced to 6 seconds (from 10 seconds)
[*] Frost Trap's size has been reduced by 33% (the size of the frost explosion is unchanged)
[*] Quick Fire now has 2 Maximum Charges (down from 3)
[*] Hail of Arrows now has 2 Maximum Charges (down from 3)
[*] Maelstrom now has 2 Maximum Charges (down from 3)
[*] Maelstrom now grants 90% increased Attack Speed (up from 25%)
[*] Maelstrom now buffs 5 Attacks (up from 4)
[/list]
[i][b]Wizard[/b][/i]
[list]
[*] The Wizard can now control up to 50 Orbs
[*] Base Orb Damage is increased to 3 (up from 2)
[*] Base Size of Orbs has been reduced by 20%
[*] Damage Size Scaling of Orbs has been reduced by 50% (Orbs can now gain a lot more damage!)
[*] Wizard can no longer learn Gemmed Glove (this will likely return in a Talent Package at a later date)
[*] Wizard can now learn [b]Dorble Up[/b] - Create two Orbs that permanently orbit you
[*] Arcane Orbs has been reworked: Create an Orb that permanently orbits you and your Ability Power strengthens your Orbs.
[*] Blazing Orbs now creates two Orbs that apply Burning (instead of making all Orbs apply Burning)
[*] Blazing Orbs no longer adds additional Orb Speed
[*] Earthen Orbs now creates two Orbs that always apply Knockback (instead of making all Orbs apply Knockback if you have 5 or more Orb Damage)
[*] Orbular Knowledge has been reworked - Gain an Orb that permanently orbits you. On Level Up your Orbs Gain 100% Speed for the next 2 seconds
[*] Atomize has been reworked: Duplicate an Orb until the end of the Night. Your Orb Damage is increased by 5 for the next 5 seconds. Atomize prioritizes special orbs.
[*] Echomancy is now a Legendary Talent and always activates (instead of having a 50% chance)
[*] Wizard can now learn [b][Evocation][/b] (Epic) - Whenever you cast a spell you reduce the cooldown of other spells that are on cooldown by 2 seconds.
[*] Insight now grants 15% increased experience on kill with Ability (down from 25%)
[*] Crystal Orbs now grants 15% increased experience on kill with Orb (down from 25%)
[*] Simple Interest now requires 2 unspent Talent Points to grant a level increase (up from 1)
[*] Full House now also grants a random Ability
[*] Burning Ambition now increases Range by 5% of unspent Talent Points (down from 10%)
[*] Burning Ambition now requires 25 unspent Talent Points to grant Piercing (up from 10)
[*] Spirit Flame damage reduction per pierce increased to 8 (up from 4)
[*] Fireball Rank 2 damage increased to 20 (from 15)
[*] Reduced the speed of Cyclone by 50% (allowing it to hit and gather up more enemies)
[*] Studious Activation Chance down to 15% (from 25%)
[*] Spell Thirst kill requirement increased to 10 (up from 5)
[*] Deep Learning also increases the spawn rate of Legendary Talents
[*] Deep Learning increases the spawn rate of non-common Talents by 25% (down from 50%)
[*] Thesis now grants two Random Common Talents (instead of two random Combat Stats)
[/list]
[i][b]Warrior[/b][/i]
[list]
[*] All Warrior Strike Abilities now have Attack Damage scaling (we listened!)
[*] Largening no longer grants a base Size Increase
[*] Largening now grants 10% Size Increase per 25 Health Points (up from 5%)
[*] Harsh Lesson now grants 50% of kill experience (up from 25%)
[*] Harsh Lesson can now also proc from Parries
[*] Earthquake now applies Wounded to all enemies hit (doubling their damage taken from all sources for 4 seconds)
[*] Warrior can no longer learn Bladework
[*] Warrior can now learn [b][Frustration][/b] (Rare) - Your maximum rage is increased by 10, you start
 each Night with 5 additional rage
[*] Warrior starting Rage has been reduced to 20
[*] Bloodlust has been reworked - The first time you reach maximum rage each night your Size is increased by 2% for every 5 Rage for the rest of the Night
[*] Blast Strike's cooldown has been increased to 15 seconds (up from 10 seconds)
[*] Thrown Around knockback requirement has been reduced to 0.5 (down from 1.0)
[*] Blood Pact has been reworked - Sacrifice 10 Health Points to gain 5% Attack Speed until the end of the night
[*] Sore Loser now also grants 1 Attack Damage until the end of the Night
[*] All Planned has been reworked - The first time you take damage each night you do not lose your combo and Knockback all surrounding enemies applying Wounded to them
[*] Pure Brilliance now grants 1 of each Common Talent (instead of 1 of each Combat Stat)
[*] Skill Cap experience increase per combo level reduced to 5% (down from 10%) [b]Note:[/b] This Talent became a lot stronger with the addition of new combo levels and the flat Experience increase on Harsh Lesson
[/list]
[i][b]Summoner[/b][/i]
[list]
[*] Soul Absorption is now an Epic Talent
[*] Soul Absorption has been reworked - Lifestealing from 20 enemies grants 5% Summon Speed until the end of the Night
[*] Laid to Rest now costs 20 Magic Points (up from 5)
[*] Laid to Rest now places a Gravestone in all 4 Lanes (instead of a single random lane)
[*] Laid to Rest's cooldown has been reduced to 20s (down from 30s)
[*] Graveyard Shift has been moved to the Base Talent Package
[*] Grave Circumstances has been moved to the Appropriation Package (from the Rest in Pieces Talent Package)
[*] The Rest In Pieces Talent Package now contains [b][Hallowed Ground][/b] - Spawn a Gravestone at the start of each Night. If there are at least 2 Gravestones present your MP Regeneration Rate is increased by 20%
[*] Vile Curses has been reworked into [b][Cursed Knowledge][/b] Whenever you Level Up you spawn a Gravestone in a random lane
[*] Bomb Shells, Flame Shells and Blight Shells Talents all have an 8% chance to activate (up from 5%)
[*] Call of the Haunted no longer grants 5 Maximum Health to Helpers upon their return
[*] Skelebob's Bone Piles no longer deal damage to Helpers
[/list]
[i][b]Meta Game[/b][/i]
[list]
[*] The unlock requirement for unlocking Warrior has been reduced to Completing Mastery 2 (from Completing Mastery 3)
[*] Lowered the Class Experience granted from a Mastery 0 run (so new players aren't bombarded with Talent Package choices)
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where connections between Talents would be invisible if an Ability Talent was rerolled into a Rare Talent
[*] Fixed a bug where Status Effects would be listed on Mystery Talents before they were learnt
[*] The Shadow from Shadow Boxing now correctly scales with Character Size
[*] Ability Procs now appear green, and no longer appear when an ability is cast
[*] Cyclone can no longer knock back Spectral Enemies
[*] Gulf's burrow particles no longer draw on top of other enemies when the Gulf itself is behind that enemy
[*] Fixed an issue where pausing the game on the run end screen would cause the music to stop entierly
[*] Fixed an issue where Fly Helpers would sometimes fly over enemies
[*] Fixed a bug where Vortech Generator would not correctly reduce the cooldown of Stim Pack
[*] Fixed a bug where Spectral Smushrooms wouldn't actually appear to be Spectral
[*] Fixed a bug where Warrior's current Rage would be reduced when they lost a Gifted Combo with [Sweet Combo] active
[*] Fixed an issue where Change of Heart would cause Bone Piles to be come undamageable and deal damage even after the night had ended
[*] Fixed several bugs that caused Talent that appeared to be connected to not actually be purchasable
[*] Fixed a bug where Busters would spawn more often than intended
[*] Fixed a graphical issue with the pillars to the left and right of the game on large aspect ratios
[*] Fixed several typos and description inaccuracies 
[*] Fixed an issue where Rares from Eureka would not count towards Rares learnt for Thesis/Dissertation
[*] Fixed an issue where Archer's arrows would sometimes pass over the heads of enemies
[/list]

Phew... Now I'm out of breath... We're so thankful for everyone who joined us on the journey to our first update, and we hope you'll stick with us to find out what is coming in 0.12!

[i]Stay Talented[/i]

notes.title: Devlog #46 - Well Rounded
notes.notes:
Hello Talented Gamers!

This will (hopefully) be my final devlog before the next update! I can't wait for everyone to get their hands on the new Bandit Class, Legendary Talents and all of the other features we've sprinkled in to respond to player feedback.

Something I want to be completely upfront about - we will be increasing the price of Talented with the 0.11 update. This was always the plan (you can even see it in our Early Access Q&A) and we've received a lot of feedback that there's plenty of content to justify it. 

That being said, we will also be immediately putting the game on sale at its previous price for a week. This gives anyone who finds us at the start of the update period a final chance to get it at the original price. Hope that sounds fair to everyone!

Let's get on to the fun stuff!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/bd514ddf17fb9bf4fa06a65da1243e21de10ef58.gif[/img]

[b]New Achievements[/b]

0.11 brings 20 brand new Achievements to unlock! Some keen eyed members of the community have already spotted them, here's a few to look out for and destroy on update day:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/4d6affb6526c50686a0f7872d2e051f764127d04.png[/img]
[i]Become the biggest know-it-all in the land[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/8d6a4de5f6cfaae912d2e0fb5fc1e30761ac6120.png[/img]
[i]Me no think, me only shoot[/i]

And of course, the Bandit has a fresh set of Class Achievements to collect!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/7e6a6f811016a35a3b0bf4d0c033e44be5211d04.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/33f250092d7826c2f40a2829d7beeab7e22e9f9d.png[/img]

[b]Class Balance[/b]

We have an absolute wealth of balance changes coming up, each class has 10 or more Talents being tweaked. Much of our balance is informed by player feedback, so do keep that rolling in! Here are just a few of the areas we'll be addressing this update...

[i][b]Archer Piercing[/b][/i]

Right now it feels like Pierce or Pain for the Archer. We're reworking pierce from the ground up and buffing other strategies to make the average run feel less like a dice roll.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/8276d4ca4a48744455a3df348aa11213a5f8bc14.png[/img]

Piercing Blows has been reworked into an Epic Talent without the Damage or Knockback reduction, and we've added a new Piercing Rare Talent that gets slightly less out of control:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/60403794b97bc37040591439f18fcb81fb7c477a.png[/img]

[b]Note:[/b] Spectral Quiver currently has placeholder art, but rest assured it will have its own icon in the update!

To compensate for this [b]All[/b] Quiver Talents now have a 5% chance to proc and Archer has a chunk more other buffs too that I will go into in the Patch Notes.

[i][b]O R B S[/b][/i]

Ah Orbs, will you ever find true balance, or will you continue to endlessly roll off the table?

For Orbs, the Elemental Orbs Talents (e.g. Blazing Orbs) no longer apply their buff to all other Orbs. This has allowed us to make the baseline power of Orbs a little higher by increasing the Speed by 25%, the Base Damage to 3 and increase the maximum Orb Count to 50.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/d705b718872f83350a77a53ef241427681dfb58b.gif[/img]

[b]Note:[/b] Earthen Orbs now always apply Knockback (the damage requirement has been removed)

We've also replaced [Gemmed Glove] with a brand new Orb Talent:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/c892c8540c76f2833275793a2dc13ace59da4e61.png[/img]

Ability Crit enjoyers need not fear, [Gemmed Glove] will return in the future when we have more support for Ability Critical Strikes!

...And just so the other classes don't feel left out!

[i][b]Strike Out![/b][/i]

Due to popular demand, all Warrior Strike Abilities now have Attack Damage scaling!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/981a073f64d1625c651f52f25685095c929825e6.png[/img]

[i][b]Music to my Soul[/b][/i]

[Soul Absorption] is now an Epic Talent in the Base Package - finally, not every run will be a machine gun snail run!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/cc31f490a53a93df1d2e51566957dfbbade3892b.png[/img]

[b]Quality of Life[/b]

In these final phases of development we've taken some time to add a few frequently requested quality of life features.

Although this is [b]not the long term plan[/b] for Talent Packages, in their current state having them randomized and out of player control is simply unfun. We've added a reroll feature to allow you to roll the dice until you get the packages you like (if you want!)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/0e4802bdf47897fbfeb045cf92b3eeaa9f3a3f87.png[/img]

Next, we've been made aware that Mastery Progression can feel a little slow for some players very familiar with this type of game. We've doubled the rate at which you can level up your Mastery by giving a second Bonus Unlock if you take less than 5 hits in a run.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/51e2c2a2555a799ab21c29e8cbc7a9774ab71d28.png[/img]

Andddd here's a few more assorted QoL features being added this update.

[list]
[*]A Slow Mode setting that reduces the in game speed to 50% of the default, but also disabling Achievements.
[*]A setting to permanently keep the stats panel open permanently.
[*]Tooltips for Health Points and Resources (e.g. Magic Points) when hovering over them, showing the current and maximum values.
[*]Restart and Next Mastery Buttons on the Run End Screen
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/186eb6185ad9fd23bd8e410732b66f6310475426.gif[/img]

That about does it for this time (and most likely this update!). There are more unannounced changes coming including a lotttt of bug fixes that will all be covered in the Patch Notes for 0.11, so keep your Googlys peeled for those.

[i]Stay Talented[/i]

notes.title: Devlog #45 - Legends Never Die
notes.notes:
Hello Talented Gamers!

We've crossed 10,000 Talented players on Steam just in time for the Holiday Season! It's the perfect time to get nostalgia for the good old days when the Talent Tree looked like this:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/88eb9f14bfe9985563bb7a351c8d0de687fed275.png[/img]

Oh.. How far we've come. However, one thing was lost to time... Do you see those... Golden...

[b]Legendary Talents[/b]

They're back and better than ever! They cost 5 Talent Points and we know at that price we need to get them right, so we had two goals for Legendaries:

[list]
[*] Legendaries should be simple but very powerful.
[*] Legendaries should never feel like a waste of Talent Points (even if they're not [i]perfect[/i] for your build)
[/list]
Here's a few examples that we feel really embody this:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/70464ed4f89e8a328b4b8c0d3b11f22620c7c433.gif[/img]

This one is for Wizard. If you have a lot of Knowledge Talents that Activate from leveling up, this is a complete game breaker - but nobody will be sad to get a handful of free Talent Points each Night.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/60d23c4cd5444aab4e9c0c67ba23e6faddc4aaa3.gif[/img]

A new Summoner rule-bender. Completely insane with Gravestone Builds, but still offers a decent amount of defensive power even if you don't have a single Talent that cares about your Graveyard.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/186eb6185ad9fd23bd8e410732b66f6310475426.gif[/img]

This is also a great opportunity to re-brand some Talents that we love but have had to be nerfed in an awkward way to fit into the power level of an epic.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/3ddeb17842a03fe56981328b846fadb0dbb87e90.gif[/img]

Replacing Twin Strike, Coral Quiver can be what we always wanted - a true double shot.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/8b8fec545ce47cb20421084c7fde18b32e8d2274.gif[/img]

Ah... the old Echomancy, back to its reliable self. (I'm sure no overpowered synergies will crop up from this)

Don't fear! Any class that has an Epic upgraded to a Legendary will be getting a brand new Epic to replace it.

Each class will have 4 Legendary Talents, with more coming in the future. You'll need to keep an eye out though - only 1-2 Legendaries will be appearing on the tree per run.

[b]You [i]Were[/i] Truly Talented[/b]

We have some changes to the Combo Meter coming in the next update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/ecdf2b92619d66368f60300421f17c6f94815f83.png[/img]

Ever since the Game Pacing changes in 0.9 we've felt like it was too easy to achieve a Talented and Truly Talented combo, and it felt especially strange that there was no Combo Level increase at 500 and 1000 kills.

So we've fixed that by adding two brand new combo levels! Here's what the combo meter will look like in 0.11:

[list]
[*] [Skilled] (+10% XP) - 20 Kills
[*] [Gifted] (+25% XP) - 50 Kills
[*] [Brilliant] (+50% XP) - 100 Kills
[*] [Masterful] (+85% XP) - 250 Kills
[*] [Talented] (+125% XP) - 500 Kills
[*] [Truly Talented] (+200% XP) - 1000 Kills
[/list]
Keen eyed players will notice a few changes to bonus experience rewards and kill requirements too, we've made sure there is a clear increase in power from each combo level and we've made the elusive [One Shot] Achievement a little less frustrating to collect.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/bd514ddf17fb9bf4fa06a65da1243e21de10ef58.gif[/img]

That's all for this time! We're getting close to hitting our content goals for this update but there's still some exciting things to announce.

Next time I will talk about some of the new Achievements coming in 0.11, some Quality of Life features and maybe even begin to discuss balance! For now...

[i]Stay Legendary[/i]

notes.title: Devlog #44 - Roll The Bones
notes.notes:
Hello Talented Gamers!

We've been hard at work fleshing out the Bandit Class that we announced in the previous devlog! I have a few more details to share, including a couple of his brand spanking new Talents and Abilities but first I want to take some time to address a few of our most common pieces of feedback.

Advanced warning that this will be a fairly systems heavy devlog, so if you're more interested in concrete features I won't be offended if you skip the next two sections!

[b]Trial and Error[/b]

We've been made [i][b]very[/b][/i] aware that our difficulty scaling is harsh to the point of being unfair, beginning around Mastery 10 and doubling down at Mastery 20.

It was never our goal to make Talented about restarting runs until you find a combination of enemies and Talents that let's you finally scrape your way past the first 10 Nights and sail your way to the end. So we're making some substantial changes to the Mastery system with 2 goals in mind:

- Make Mastery 10 - 25 more achievable with a higher number of builds
- Move more of the difficulty of Mastery 10 - 25 into the later portion of the game (Nights 10 - 20)

And how will we achieve this?... (Spoilers for Mastery Levels ahead)

- Replaced the Mastery 10 penalty that increased the cost of Rare, Epic and Ability Talents with one that adds a new Enemy Type at Night 10 and Night 15
- Replaced the Mastery 20 penalty that added an extra enemy per wave with one that increases the power of Elite Enemies (+25% HP, +10% Speed)
- The Mastery 25 penalty now only gives double enemy upgrades from Night 5 onwards
- Reduced the chance of Mystery Talents by 5% per Mastery Penalty (from 10%)
- Reduced the vision range cap by 5% per Mastery Penalty (from 10%)
- All per-night Mastery Penalties from Mastery 11 onwards only come into effect after Night 10 (e.g. "Enemies gain 1% movement speed each night" >> "After Night 10, Enemies gain 1% movement speed each night"

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/9cdd3742b91ce1e935cbe9138fe337e1281ef494.png[/img]

As well as making the game generally a lot fairer, this should push a very significant portion of the challenge into the final 10 Nights - allowing you to establish a build before the difficulty really ramps up.

Our plan is to add the Mastery changes to a Hotfix for 0.10, so you won't need until 0.11 to get these. They should be live in the coming days!

[b]Taking a Chance[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/32568558a91d0ee1d9a6d6790f68634a06c338cf.png[/img]

Since the early days the Common that appeared on the tree were pulled completely at random from the pool of available Talented. Sometimes this worked in your favor (I've seen screenshots of people with 10 Damage on Archer on Night 3!), but often it can lead to situations where you simply cannot find the Talents you need.

To help solve this issue we've moved to a random pooling system.

When the Talent Tree is created at the start of a run Common Talents fill a pool and whenever a Common Talent is placed on the tree it is removed from the pool. Only when the pool is empty does it refill completely again. 

[b]Note:[/b] Some Common Talents appear multiple times in the pool and others don't. For example, 
the [Attack Speed Up] talent appears in the pool 4 times for Archer but the [Damage Up] talent only appears once.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/3bac7b8ea1bc2a97eb4829b4b5f1584dd4828d9e.png[/img]

This means that all possible Common Talents will be more evenly spread throughout the tree, and you should have more consistent access to whatever you're looking for.

Several other areas of the game have benefited from this system too. Rare Talents, Abilities, Enemy Spawns and even Enemy Wave Sizes all use the pooling system. We hope this will lead to more consistent and fairer feeling runs.

[b]The Fun Stuff[/b]

Thank you for indulging us by reading the, slightly more dry, balance talk above! Let's reveal some Bandit Abilities!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/faf226f78d2b45285131ea1ec6a055fe7b5c0e4d.png[/img]

I mentioned last time that some Talents would allow you to fire more bullets. Something worth noting is, Bandit will [i]not[/i] have access to the [Damage Up] talent so you'd better stack up those shots!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/17b1cd8e5f39b76e93e0ef0950d74db3f04d0da2.png[/img]

Bullets won't be the only thing you're firing, Fireworks can provide some useful crowd-control for tanky enemies that you can't finish off without reloading.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/4c0a788ee8226ac68eef37365dafbd27ec214810.png[/img]

Now you've stuffed your gun full of extra shots, challenge an entire lane to a duel while the others look on in awe.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/1d1a2a202ea1683af87c58d2126dfc62c5338138.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/bd514ddf17fb9bf4fa06a65da1243e21de10ef58.gif[/img]

Phew! That was a lot to talk about, so I won't keep you any longer. I can't say too much about the next devlog, but it will be... Legendary...

[i]Stay Talented[/i]

notes.title: Devlog #43 - High Noon
notes.notes:
Hello Talented Gamers!

THE NEXT CLASS IS... [b]BANDIT[/b]. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/435b34b9b4c6d7b1e76a4b780c39bad139a009bd.png[/img]

I've been wanting to say that for weeks at this point, and oh boy, is there a lot to talk about!

[b]Cash Money[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/2d1b70de4bed04b06a9ebe98b720730aabef89af.gif[/img]

The Bandit has access to a brand new resource [b]Gold Coins[/b]. We had so much positive feedback for the Archer's loot mechanic that we've made it a fundamental part of how the Bandit works!

Bandit has a brand new stat called Luck. Your percentage chance for an enemy to drop a Gold Coin when they die. 

Luck can be increased by learning the Common [Luck Up] Talents, so while you start with a handful of pennies you can earn some fat stacks later in the run.

But where will you spend all of this hard earned dollar?

[b]Big Spender[/b]

There are two main ways to empty your savings account!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/4875c69975f1e0f48950f53e00562088d4490750.png[/img]
The first is the Talent Shop. Accessed through the Talent [Cash Out] you can go on a shopping spree - buying Common Talents, Rare Talents and even Abilities and Epics if you're lucky enough to find them!

You can also slam that Re-Roll Button to re-fill the shop or get any unwanted options out of your sight... but beware, the price of Re-Rolling increases with every press!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/4b4865aa49ed189adb3defce55984d4db7093c37.png[/img]
The other way to spend your hard earned money is on Abilities! That's right, the Bandit is Pay-to-Win (this is a joke).

Will you save up your coin to spend in the Talent Shop? Will you overspend and end up bankrupt at the exact moment where an extra use of an Ability would have saved you? Time will tell...

[b]Shoot to Kill[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/7c862d33294885b9c8694cf605c1746f6f85c16d.gif[/img]

But that's not all... Every single Bandit Basic Attack will fire two bullets, and with some of their new Talents you'll be firing even more!

What's the down side you say?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/1e39675b3841811fea86d5034fed800b54828320.gif[/img]

The Bandit can only fire three times before he needs to reload his weapon - so you'd better pick your targets wisely as the enemies won't wait around.

Never fear though, you can use [Reload Speed Up] Talents and some Abilities (more about those next Devlog) to reload faster!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/bd514ddf17fb9bf4fa06a65da1243e21de10ef58.gif[/img]

Aaaaand that about wraps it up for this time! There's plenty more to share, so expect to hear more detail about the Talents and Abilities that Bandit has in the coming weeks. Including some brand new Status Effects!

[i]Stay Talented[/i]

notes.title: Devlog #42 - A New Challenge
notes.notes:
Hello Talented Gamers!

It's been a truly amazing first week for Talented - 3259 people and counting have picked up the game and the vast majority of the feedback has been extremely positive and constructive. We cannot thank you enough for that - we take the move to Steam very seriously and it's good to see that our work to make a solid groundwork before releasing paid off!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/bd514ddf17fb9bf4fa06a65da1243e21de10ef58.gif[/img]

[b]Some Ground Rules[/b]

This is a continuation of a devlog I've been running since the start of Talented over on itch.io, if you'd like to see more about the history of the game we've worked hard making do head over there! I aim to get these out around every 2 weeks (but sometimes life gets in the way!).

[i]Just so we're being completely transparent, anything discussed in these devlogs is subject to change - they're intended to be an insight into development rather than concrete feature announcements! (although we do our best to only mention things we're confident are coming)[/i]

But I know what's really on everyone's mind! What's next for Talent Ed?...

[b]New Challenger Approaches[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/0b8e46ac0dbea4eb715204fc2353ed2b42dcd41b.png[/img]

The first thing on the list for 0.11 is our 5th Character Class, this is the first one we've developed since the Summoner in 2021!

We're committed to getting right, so we don't want to reveal anything until we're happy with how it's looking internally - but I can tell you we are prototyping a completely new resource and trying out a second way of getting Talents, both unique mechanics for Talented!

[b]Legend Has It[/b]

Something I've wanted to do ever since Version 0.1 is a tier of *extremely* powerful Talents, that bend the rules even further than Epics.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/186eb6185ad9fd23bd8e410732b66f6310475426.gif[/img]

This update, finally, I get my wish with [b]Legendary Talents[/b]. These Talents will cost more Talent Points than any other and only one will be available on the tree each run - but should you find it here are a few of the effects we're thinking:

[b][Bullseye][/b] [i](Archer)[/i] Double your Critical Strike Chance
[b][Overconfident][/b] [i](Warrior)[/i] Your Combo Meter doesn't reset at the end of the Night
[b][Scourge][/b] [i](Summoner)[/i] Enemies have a 25% chance to spawn a fly on death

Additionally, some Talents that have had to be nerfed in order to remain Epic Talents will be upgraded to Legendary. For example:

[b][Echomancy][/b] [i](Wizard)[/i] Whenever you cast an ability, that ability will cast a second time for free after a short delay

[b]Note:[/b] The plan with all Legendary Talents is for them to be useful (if not ideal) in any build, that way you'll never be sad to see them.

[b]We've Listened![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388421/8f27206e2dee4039b01b7ea05c1707f6e6311d1d.png[/img]

Finally, we want to take some time to address some of the major areas of feedback on the 0.10 build. The two points we want to focus on for 0.11 are:

- Certain classes being reliant on specific Talents/Builds.
- Mastery 10+ feeling difficult in an unfair way.

We'll dig into both of these in a future devlog, but needless to say, things like Archer's reliance on [Piercing Blows] and Wizard's Orb build are definitely on our radar for next update. You can also expect changes that shift more of the high Mastery challenge into the late game of the run, giving you more time to craft a build before feeling the need to restart.

Phew, that was a lot - thank you so much if you made it through! Please keep the feedback rolling in, we're dedicated to making Talented the best game we can. Next time I'll hopefully be able to go into more detail on the new class.

[i]Stay Talented[/i]
